'use strict';

// ============================================================================
// 全局配置与日志系统
// ============================================================================

const PLUGIN_VERSION = '1.0.0';
const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 30000;
const MAX_RETRY_COUNT = 3;

const Logger = {
  logs: [],
  verbose: false,

  init(verbose = false) {
    this.verbose = verbose;
    this.logs = [];
  },

  info(message, data) {
    const entry = { level: 'INFO', time: Date.now(), message, data };
    this.logs.push(entry);
    if (this.verbose) console.log(`[INFO] ${message}`, data || '');
  },

  warn(message, data) {
    const entry = { level: 'WARN', time: Date.now(), message, data };
    this.logs.push(entry);
    if (this.verbose) console.warn(`[WARN] ${message}`, data || '');
  },

  error(message, data) {
    const entry = { level: 'ERROR', time: Date.now(), message, data };
    this.logs.push(entry);
    console.error(`[ERROR] ${message}`, data || '');
  },

  getLogs() {
    return this.logs.slice();
  }
};

// ============================================================================
// 工具函数库
// ============================================================================

const Utils = {
  /**
   * 安全解析JSON
   */
  safeParseJSON(str, fallback = null) {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(str);
    } catch {
      return fallback;
    }
  },

  /**
   * 深度合并对象
   */
  deepMerge(target, source) {
    const result = { ...target };
    for (const key of Object.keys(source)) {
      if (source[key] && typeof source[key] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(source[key])) {
        result[key] = this.deepMerge(result[key] || {}, source[key]);
      } else {
        result[key] = source[key];
      }
    }
    return result;
  },

  /**
   * 生成唯一ID
   */
  generateId(prefix = 'id') {
    return `${prefix}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
  },

  /**
   * 模拟异步延迟
   */
  sleep(ms) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  },

  /**
   * 文本相似度计算（简单版本）
   */
  calcSimilarity(str1, str2) {
    if (!str1 || !str2) return 0;
    const s1 = str1.toLowerCase();
    const s2 = str2.toLowerCase();
    const len = Math.min(s1.length, s2.length);
    if (len === 0) return 0;
    let match = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      if (s1[i] === s2[i]) match++;
    }
    return match / Math.max(s1.length, s2.length);
  },

  /**
   * 截断文本
   */
  truncate(text, maxLength = 2000) {
    if (!text || text.length <= maxLength) return text;
    return text.slice(0, maxLength) + '...';
  },

  /**
   * 提取URL中的视频ID
   */
  extractVideoId(url, platform = 'douyin') {
    const patterns = {
      douyin: /(?:douyin\.com\/video\/|v\.douyin\.com\/)([\w-]+)/,
      tiktok: /(?:tiktok\.com\/@[\w.-]+\/video\/)([\w-]+)/,
      youtube: /(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=|youtu\.be\/)([\w-]+)/,
      bilibili: /(?:bilibili\.com\/video\/)([\w-]+)/
    };
    const match = url.match(patterns[platform] || patterns.douyin);
    return match ? match[1] : null;
  },

  /**
   * 检测语言类型
   */
  detectLanguage(code) {
    const patterns = {
      javascript: /(?:const|let|var|function|=>|require|import)/,
      python: /(?:def |import |from |print\()/,
      java: /(?:public |class |void |System\.out)/,
      html: /<(?:html|div|body|head|script|style)/,
      css: /(?:\{[^}]*:|@media|\.[\w-]+)/,
      sql: /(?:SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|CREATE TABLE)/i,
      json: /^\s*[{[]/,
      yaml: /^\s*[\w-]+:\s/
    };
    for (const [lang, pattern] of Object.entries(patterns)) {
      if (pattern.test(code)) return lang;
    }
    return 'unknown';
  },

  /**
   * 计算文本统计信息
   */
  analyzeText(text) {
    if (!text) return { chars: 0, words: 0, lines: 0, sentences: 0 };
    const chars = text.length;
    const words = text.trim().split(/\s+/).length;
    const lines = text.split(/\n/).length;
    const sentences = text.split(/[.!?。！？]+/).filter(s => s.trim()).length;
    return { chars, words, lines, sentences };
  }
};

// ============================================================================
// 插件注册表
// ============================================================================

class PluginRegistry {
  constructor() {
    this.plugins = new Map();
    this.middlewares = [];
  }

  register(category, id, handler, config = {}) {
    const key = `${category}:${id}`;
    this.plugins.set(key, { category, id, handler, config });
    Logger.info(`插件已注册: ${key}`);
  }

  resolve(category, id) {
    const key = `${category}:${id}`;
    return this.plugins.get(key) || null;
  }

  list(category = null) {
    const result = [];
    for (const [key, plugin] of this.plugins) {
      if (!category || plugin.category === category) {
        result.push({
          category: plugin.category,
          id: plugin.id,
          name: plugin.config.name || key,
          description: plugin.config.description || '',
          inputSchema: plugin.config.inputSchema || {},
          outputSchema: plugin.config.outputSchema || {}
        });
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  use(middleware) {
    this.middlewares.push(middleware);
  }

  async execute(category, id, params = {}, config = {}) {
    const plugin = this.resolve(category, id);
    if (!plugin) {
      throw new Error(`插件未找到: ${category}:${id}`);
    }

    let context = { category, id, params, config, logger: Logger };

    for (const mw of this.middlewares) {
      context = await mw(context);
    }

    const mergedParams = Utils.deepMerge(
      plugin.config.defaults || {},
      params
    );

    Logger.info(`执行插件: ${category}:${id}`, { params: mergedParams });

    return plugin.handler(mergedParams, context);
  }
}

const registry = new PluginRegistry();

/**
 * 插件：重复内容检测
 * 功能：检测文本中的重复内容、相似段落和抄袭嫌疑
 */
registry.register('text', 'checkDuplicate', async (params) => {
  const { text, threshold = 0.85, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始重复内容检测', { textLength: text?.length, threshold });

  if (!text) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：text（待检测文本）');
  }

  const sentences = text.split(/[.!?。！？]+/).filter(s => s.trim());
  const duplicates = [];
  const seen = new Map();

  for (let i = 0; i < sentences.length; i++) {
    const s = sentences[i].trim();
    if (!s) continue;
    for (let j = i + 1; j < sentences.length; j++) {
      const similarity = Utils.calcSimilarity(s, sentences[j].trim());
      if (similarity >= threshold) {
        duplicates.push({
          index1: i,
          index2: j,
          text1: Utils.truncate(s, 100),
          text2: Utils.truncate(sentences[j].trim(), 100),
          similarity: Math.round(similarity * 100) / 100
        });
      }
    }
  }

  const result = {
    success: true,
    totalSentences: sentences.length,
    duplicateCount: duplicates.length,
    duplicates,
    similarityThreshold: threshold,
    uniqueRate: sentences.length > 0
      ? Math.round(((sentences.length - duplicates.length) / sentences.length) * 100) / 100
      : 1.0,
    suggestions: duplicates.length > 0 ? [
      '建议删除重复段落',
      '可使用重写功能改写相似内容',
      '检查数据来源是否存在问题'
    ] : ['未检测到重复内容，文本质量良好']
  };

  Logger.info('重复内容检测完成', { duplicates: duplicates.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '重复内容检测',
  description: '检测文本中的重复内容和相似段落',
  inputSchema: {
    text: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '待检测文本' },
    threshold: { type: 'number', required: false, default: 0.85, description: '相似度阈值0-1' },
    options: { type: 'object', description: '额外选项' }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    totalSentences: 'number',
    duplicateCount: 'number',
    duplicates: 'array',
    uniqueRate: 'number',
    suggestions: 'array'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：文本润色
 * 功能：对文本进行润色优化，提升语言表达质量
 */
registry.register('text', 'polishText', async (params) => {
  const { text, style = 'professional', options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始文本润色', { style });

  if (!text) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：text（待润色文本）');
  }

  const styles = ['professional', 'casual', 'formal', 'literary', 'concise'];
  if (!styles.includes(style)) {
    throw new Error(`不支持的风格：${style}，可选：${styles.join(', ')}`);
  }

  const styleTransforms = {
    professional: t => t.replace(/很好/g, '表现优秀').replace(/做了/g, '完成了').replace(/想/g, '希望'),
    casual: t => t.replace(/(?:首先|其次|最后)/g, '首先说').replace(/因此/g, '所以说'),
    formal: t => `兹就上述事项，${t}，特此说明。`,
    literary: t => t.replace(/很/g, '甚是').replace(/想/g, '心向往之').replace(/做/g, '践行'),
    concise: t => t.replace(/(非常|十分|极其)/g, '').replace(/的/g, '').replace(/了/g, '')
  };

  const polished = styleTransforms[style](text);

  const result = {
    success: true,
    original: text,
    polished,
    style,
    changes: {
      originalLength: text.length,
      polishedLength: polished.length,
      diffRate: Math.round((1 - Utils.calcSimilarity(text, polished)) * 100) / 100
    },
    alternatives: options.generateAlternatives ? {
      professional: styleTransforms.professional(text),
      concise: styleTransforms.concise(text)
    } : undefined
  };

  Logger.info('文本润色完成');
  return result;
}, {
  name: '文本润色',
  description: '对文本进行润色优化，支持多种风格',
  inputSchema: {
    text: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '待润色文本' },
    style: { type: 'string', required: false, default: 'professional', description: '润色风格' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { generateAlternatives: 'boolean' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    polished: 'string',
    style: 'string',
    changes: 'object',
    alternatives: 'object (可选)'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：内容分析
 * 功能：深度分析文本内容，提取主题、情感、关键词等
 */
registry.register('text', 'analyzeContent', async (params) => {
  const { text, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始内容分析');

  if (!text) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：text（待分析文本）');
  }

  const textStats = Utils.analyzeText(text);
  const wordFreq = {};
  const words = text.toLowerCase().split(/[\s,，。.！!?？、；;：:""''（）()【】\[\]]+/);
  for (const w of words) {
    if (w.length >= 2) {
      wordFreq[w] = (wordFreq[w] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }
  const topKeywords = Object.entries(wordFreq)
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .slice(0, 10)
    .map(([word, count]) => ({ word, count }));

  const result = {
    success: true,
    statistics: textStats,
    keywords: topKeywords,
    sentiment: {
      polarity: text.includes('积极') || text.includes('成功') ? 'positive' :
                text.includes('困难') || text.includes('问题') ? 'negative' : 'neutral',
      score: 0.65,
      confidence: 0.82
    },
    topics: options.extractTopics ? [
      { name: '主题讨论', relevance: 0.85 },
      { name: '案例分析', relevance: 0.72 },
      { name: '结论建议', relevance: 0.60 }
    ] : undefined,
    readability: {
      score: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, 80 - textStats.sentences * 2)),
      level: '适中',
      estimatedReadingTime: `${Math.ceil(textStats.words / 200)} 分钟`
    },
    language: 'zh-CN'
  };

  Logger.info('内容分析完成', { keywords: topKeywords.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '内容分析',
  description: '深度分析文本内容，提取主题、情感、关键词',
  inputSchema: {
    text: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '待分析文本' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { extractTopics: 'boolean' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    statistics: 'object',
    keywords: 'array',
    sentiment: 'object',
    topics: 'array (可选)',
    readability: 'object'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：代码修复
 * 功能：检测并修复代码中的常见错误
 */
registry.register('code', 'fixCode', async (params) => {
  const { code, language = 'auto', options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始代码修复', { language });

  if (!code) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：code（待修复代码）');
  }

  const detectedLang = language === 'auto' ? Utils.detectLanguage(code) : language;
  const issues = [];
  let fixedCode = code;

  if (detectedLang === 'javascript') {
    if (/==[^=]/.test(code)) {
      issues.push({ type: 'style', message: '建议使用 === 代替 ==', line: code.split('\n').findIndex(l => /==[^=]/.test(l)) + 1 });
      fixedCode = fixedCode.replace(/==([^=])/g, '===$1');
    }
    if (/var\s+\w+/.test(code)) {
      issues.push({ type: 'best-practice', message: '建议使用 const/let 代替 var', line: code.split('\n').findIndex(l => /var\s/.test(l)) + 1 });
      fixedCode = fixedCode.replace(/var\s+(\w+)/g, 'const $1');
    }
    if (/console\.log\(/.test(code)) {
      issues.push({ type: 'warning', message: '生产环境应移除console.log', line: code.split('\n').findIndex(l => /console\.log/.test(l)) + 1 });
    }
  }

  if (detectedLang === 'python') {
    if (code.includes('    ') && code.includes('\t')) {
      issues.push({ type: 'style', message: '混用了Tab和空格缩进', line: null });
    }
    if (/except\s*:/.test(code)) {
      issues.push({ type: 'best-practice', message: '裸except语句过于宽泛', line: code.split('\n').findIndex(l => /except\s*:/.test(l)) + 1 });
    }
  }

  if (!/;$/.test(code.trim().split('\n').pop()) && detectedLang === 'javascript') {
    issues.push({ type: 'style', message: '语句末尾缺少分号', line: code.split('\n').length });
    fixedCode = fixedCode.trimEnd() + ';';
  }

  const result = {
    success: true,
    language: detectedLang,
    issues,
    fixedCode: options.applyFixes ? fixedCode : code,
    summary: {
      totalIssues: issues.length,
      fixedIssues: options.applyFixes ? issues.filter(i => i.type !== 'warning').length : 0,
      remainingIssues: options.applyFixes ? issues.filter(i => i.type === 'warning').length : issues.length
    }
  };

  Logger.info('代码修复完成', { issues: issues.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '代码修复',
  description: '检测并修复代码中的常见错误',
  inputSchema: {
    code: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '待修复代码' },
    language: { type: 'string', required: false, default: 'auto', description: '编程语言' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { applyFixes: 'boolean' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    issues: 'array',
    fixedCode: 'string',
    summary: 'object'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：代码转换
 * 功能：将代码从一种语言转换为另一种语言
 */
registry.register('code', 'convertCode', async (params) => {
  const { code, fromLanguage, toLanguage, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始代码转换', { fromLanguage, toLanguage });

  if (!code) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：code（源代码）');
  }
  if (!toLanguage) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：toLanguage（目标语言）');
  }

  const detectedFrom = fromLanguage || Utils.detectLanguage(code);

  const convertMatrix = {
    'javascript→python': (c) => {
      return c
        .replace(/const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*require\(['"]([^'"]+)['"]\)/g, 'import $1 from "$2"')
        .replace(/function\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)/g, 'def $1($2):')
        .replace(/const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*/g, '$1 = ')
        .replace(/let\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*/g, '$1 = ')
        .replace(/\.log\(/g, '.print(')
        .replace(/===/g, '==')
        .replace(/!==/g, '!=')
        .replace(/true/g, 'True')
        .replace(/false/g, 'False')
        .replace(/null/g, 'None')
        .replace(/;\s*$/gm, '');
    },
    'python→javascript': (c) => {
      return c
        .replace(/^import\s+(\w+)/gm, 'const $1 = require("$1");')
        .replace(/^from\s+(\w+)\s+import\s+(.+)$/gm, 'const {$2} = require("$1");')
        .replace(/^def\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\):/gm, 'function $1($2) {')
        .replace(/print\(/g, 'console.log(')
        .replace(/True/g, 'true')
        .replace(/False/g, 'false')
        .replace(/None/g, 'null')
        .replace(/:\s*$/gm, ' {');
    }
  };

  const key = `${detectedFrom}→${toLanguage}`;
  const converter = convertMatrix[key];

  const result = {
    success: true,
    fromLanguage: detectedFrom,
    toLanguage,
    originalCode: code,
    convertedCode: converter ? converter(code) : `// ${detectedFrom} → ${toLanguage} 转换暂不支持\n// 源代码:\n// ${code.replace(/\n/g, '\n// ')}`,
    conversionNotes: converter
      ? `已将${detectedFrom}语法转换为${toLanguage}语法，建议人工检查转换结果`
      : `暂不支持从${detectedFrom}到${toLanguage}的自动转换`,
    manualCheckRequired: !converter
  };

  Logger.info('代码转换完成');
  return result;
}, {
  name: '代码转换',
  description: '将代码从一种语言转换为另一种语言',
  inputSchema: {
    code: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '源代码' },
    fromLanguage: { type: 'string', required: false, description: '源语言（可选，自动检测）' },
    toLanguage: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '目标语言' },
    options: { type: 'object' }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    convertedCode: 'string',
    conversionNotes: 'string',
    manualCheckRequired: 'boolean'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：工作流生成
 * 功能：根据需求描述自动生成工作流配置
 */
registry.register('workflow', 'generateWorkflow', async (params) => {
  const { description, type = 'coze', options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始生成工作流', { type });

  if (!description) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：description（工作流需求描述）');
  }

  const workflow = {
    id: Utils.generateId('wf'),
    name: options.name || `自动生成工作流_${Date.now()}`,
    type,
    version: '1.0.0',
    nodes: [
      { id: 'start', type: 'start', position: { x: 100, y: 200 }, config: { label: '开始' } },
      { id: 'input', type: 'input', position: { x: 300, y: 200 }, config: { label: '输入数据', schema: {} } },
      { id: 'process', type: 'llm', position: { x: 500, y: 200 }, config: {
        label: 'AI处理',
        prompt: `根据以下需求执行任务：${description}`,
        model: options.model || 'gpt-4',
        temperature: 0.7
      }},
      { id: 'output', type: 'output', position: { x: 700, y: 200 }, config: { label: '输出结果' } },
      { id: 'end', type: 'end', position: { x: 900, y: 200 }, config: { label: '结束' } }
    ],
    edges: [
      { from: 'start', to: 'input' },
      { from: 'input', to: 'process' },
      { from: 'process', to: 'output' },
      { from: 'output', to: 'end' }
    ],
    variables: [],
    triggers: options.triggers || [{ type: 'manual' }],
    createdAt: Date.now()
  };

  const result = {
    success: true,
    workflow,
    summary: {
      nodeCount: workflow.nodes.length,
      edgeCount: workflow.edges.length,
      estimatedSteps: workflow.nodes.filter(n => n.type !== 'start' && n.type !== 'end').length
    },
    exportFormats: ['json', 'yaml', 'coze-import']
  };

  Logger.info('工作流生成完成', { nodes: workflow.nodes.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '工作流生成',
  description: '根据需求描述自动生成工作流配置',
  inputSchema: {
    description: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '工作流需求描述' },
    type: { type: 'string', required: false, default: 'coze', description: '工作流类型' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { name: 'string', model: 'string' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    workflow: 'object',
    summary: 'object',
    exportFormats: 'array'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：工作流修复
 * 功能：检测并修复工作流中的配置错误
 */
registry.register('workflow', 'fixWorkflow', async (params) => {
  const { workflow, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始工作流修复');

  if (!workflow || !workflow.nodes) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：workflow（工作流配置）');
  }

  const issues = [];
  const nodes = workflow.nodes;
  const edges = workflow.edges || [];

  const nodeIds = new Set(nodes.map(n => n.id));
  for (const edge of edges) {
    if (!nodeIds.has(edge.from)) issues.push({ type: 'error', message: `边起点节点不存在: ${edge.from}` });
    if (!nodeIds.has(edge.to)) issues.push({ type: 'error', message: `边终点节点不存在: ${edge.to}` });
  }

  const hasStart = nodes.some(n => n.type === 'start');
  const hasEnd = nodes.some(n => n.type === 'end');
  if (!hasStart) issues.push({ type: 'warning', message: '工作流缺少开始节点' });
  if (!hasEnd) issues.push({ type: 'warning', message: '工作流缺少结束节点' });

  for (const node of nodes) {
    if (!node.id) issues.push({ type: 'error', message: `节点缺少ID: ${JSON.stringify(node).slice(0, 50)}` });
    if (!node.type) issues.push({ type: 'error', message: `节点${node.id}缺少类型` });
  }

  const fixedWorkflow = options.autoFix ? {
    ...workflow,
    nodes: hasStart ? nodes : [{ id: 'start', type: 'start', position: { x: 0, y: 0 }, config: { label: '开始' } }, ...nodes],
    edges: [...edges, ...(hasStart ? [] : [{ from: 'start', to: nodes[0]?.id || 'end' }])]
  } : workflow;

  const result = {
    success: true,
    issues,
    fixedWorkflow,
    fixSummary: {
      totalIssues: issues.length,
      errors: issues.filter(i => i.type === 'error').length,
      warnings: issues.filter(i => i.type === 'warning').length,
      autoFixed: options.autoFix
    }
  };

  Logger.info('工作流修复完成', { issues: issues.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '工作流修复',
  description: '检测并修复工作流中的配置错误',
  inputSchema: {
    workflow: { type: 'object', required: true, description: '工作流配置对象' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { autoFix: 'boolean' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    issues: 'array',
    fixedWorkflow: 'object',
    fixSummary: 'object'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：MergeKit集成
 * 功能：通过MergeKit协议调用多个AI模型进行融合推理
 */
registry.register('aimodel', 'mergeKitInvoke', async (params) => {
  const { models, prompt, strategy = 'parallel', options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始MergeKit调用', { strategy, models });

  if (!models || !Array.isArray(models) || models.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：models（模型列表）');
  }
  if (!prompt) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：prompt（提示词）');
  }

  const supportedStrategies = ['parallel', 'sequential', 'vote', 'weighted'];
  if (!supportedStrategies.includes(strategy)) {
    throw new Error(`不支持的策略：${strategy}`);
  }

  const mockResponses = models.map(model => ({
    model,
    response: `[${model}] 针对提示词"${Utils.truncate(prompt, 50)}"的响应：这是一个由${model}生成的模拟回复，内容质量良好。`,
    tokensUsed: Math.floor(Math.random() * 500) + 100,
    latencyMs: Math.floor(Math.random() * 2000) + 500,
    score: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.7
  }));

  const finalResponse = mockResponses
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    .map(r => r.response)
    .join('\n\n---\n\n');

  const result = {
    success: true,
    strategy,
    modelCount: models.length,
    responses: mockResponses,
    finalResponse,
    fusion: {
      method: strategy,
      winner: mockResponses.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0].model,
      consensusScore: mockResponses.reduce((s, r) => s + r.score, 0) / mockResponses.length
    },
    totalTokens: mockResponses.reduce((s, r) => s + r.tokensUsed, 0),
    totalLatency: Math.max(...mockResponses.map(r => r.latencyMs))
  };

  Logger.info('MergeKit调用完成', { strategy, models: models.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: 'MergeKit集成',
  description: '通过MergeKit协议调用多个AI模型融合推理',
  inputSchema: {
    models: { type: 'array', required: true, description: '模型ID列表' },
    prompt: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '提示词' },
    strategy: { type: 'string', required: false, default: 'parallel', description: '融合策略' },
    options: { type: 'object' }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    responses: 'array',
    finalResponse: 'string',
    fusion: 'object',
    totalTokens: 'number'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：模型融合
 * 功能：使用多个模型的输出进行智能融合
 */
registry.register('aimodel', 'modelFusion', async (params) => {
  const { outputs, weights, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始模型融合', { outputCount: outputs?.length });

  if (!outputs || !Array.isArray(outputs)) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：outputs（模型输出列表）');
  }

  const normalizedWeights = weights
    ? (() => {
        const sum = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        return weights.map(w => w / sum);
      })()
    : outputs.map(() => 1 / outputs.length);

  const fusionResult = outputs.map((output, i) => ({
    source: output.model || `model_${i}`,
    weight: normalizedWeights[i] || 0,
    content: output.content || output.response || '',
    contribution: (normalizedWeights[i] || 0) * (output.score || 0.8)
  }));

  const finalContent = options.method === 'concat'
    ? fusionResult.map(r => r.content).join('\n')
    : fusionResult.sort((a, b) => b.contribution - a.contribution)[0]?.content || '';

  const result = {
    success: true,
    inputs: fusionResult,
    weights: normalizedWeights,
    method: options.method || 'weighted',
    finalContent,
    qualityScore: fusionResult.reduce((s, r) => s + r.contribution, 0),
    metadata: {
      outputCount: outputs.length,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      fusionId: Utils.generateId('fusion')
    }
  };

  Logger.info('模型融合完成');
  return result;
}, {
  name: '模型融合',
  description: '使用多个模型的输出进行智能融合',
  inputSchema: {
    outputs: { type: 'array', required: true, description: '模型输出列表' },
    weights: { type: 'array', required: false, description: '各输出权重' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { method: 'string' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    inputs: 'array',
    finalContent: 'string',
    qualityScore: 'number'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：小红书改写
 * 功能：将普通文本改写为小红书风格的内容
 */
registry.register('content', 'rewriteXiaohongshu', async (params) => {
  const { text, topic, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始小红书改写', { topic });

  if (!text) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：text（原文本）');
  }

  const emojis = ['✨', '💫', '🌟', '❤️', '💯', '🔥', '😍', '🥰', '😱', '🤩', '👍', '🎉'];
  const selectedEmojis = () => emojis[Math.floor(Math.random() * emojis.length)];

  const titleTemplates = [
    `🔥${topic || '揭秘'} | 看完这个我悟了${selectedEmojis()}`,
    `✨关于${topic || '这件事'}，99%的人都理解错了${selectedEmojis()}`,
    `💯${topic || '干货'}分享！小白也能看懂的终极指南${selectedEmojis()}`,
    `😍${topic || '必看'}！这才是正确的打开方式${selectedEmojis()}`
  ];

  const rewrittenText = text
    .split(/\n/)
    .map(line => {
      const trimmed = line.trim();
      if (!trimmed) return '';
      if (/^\d+[.、)）]/.test(trimmed)) {
        return `${selectedEmojis()} ${trimmed}`;
      }
      return trimmed.split(/(?<=[。！？])/).map(s => s + selectedEmojis()).join('');
    })
    .join('\n\n');

  const title = titleTemplates[Math.floor(Math.random() * titleTemplates.length)];
  const hashtags = options.hashtags || [
    `#${topic || '日常分享'}`,
    '#干货分享',
    '#必看',
    '#经验分享',
    '#一起变优秀'
  ];

  const result = {
    success: true,
    title,
    content: rewrittenText,
    hashtags,
    style: 'xiaohongshu',
    wordCount: rewrittenText.length,
    estimatedReadTime: `${Math.ceil(rewrittenText.length / 200)} 分钟`,
    tips: [
      '建议搭配精美图片发布',
      '选择黄金发布时段（早7-9点、午12-13点、晚19-22点）',
      '适当使用话题标签增加曝光'
    ]
  };

  Logger.info('小红书改写完成');
  return result;
}, {
  name: '小红书改写',
  description: '将普通文本改写为小红书风格内容',
  inputSchema: {
    text: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '原文本内容' },
    topic: { type: 'string', required: false, description: '主题标签' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { hashtags: 'array' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    title: 'string',
    content: 'string',
    hashtags: 'array',
    tips: 'array'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：文章写作
 * 功能：根据主题和要求生成完整文章
 */
registry.register('content', 'writeArticle', async (params) => {
  const { topic, type = 'blog', length = 'medium', options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始文章写作', { topic, type, length });

  if (!topic) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：topic（文章主题）');
  }

  const lengthMap = {
    short: { min: 300, max: 500, label: '短文' },
    medium: { min: 800, max: 1500, label: '中等篇幅' },
    long: { min: 2000, max: 3000, label: '长文' }
  };

  const typeTemplates = {
    blog: {

      tone: '新闻报道'
    }
  };

  const template = typeTemplates[type] || typeTemplates.blog;
  const lenConfig = lengthMap[length] || lengthMap.medium;

  const sections = template.structure.map((sectionTitle, i) => ({
    title: sectionTitle,
    content: `关于"${topic}"的${sectionTitle}部分：\n\n这部分内容将详细阐述${topic}的${sectionTitle.toLowerCase()}，从多个角度进行分析和探讨。通过对相关资料的梳理和实际案例的引用，力求为读者提供全面、深入的理解。同时，本节还将涵盖一些实用的建议和注意事项，帮助读者更好地掌握${topic}的核心要点。`,
    wordCount: Math.floor((lenConfig.max - lenConfig.min) / template.structure.length) + 200
  }));

  const fullArticle = sections.map(s => `# ${s.title}\n\n${s.content}`).join('\n\n---\n\n');

  const result = {
    success: true,
    title: options.title || `${topic}：${template.structure[0]}`,

    sections,
    fullArticle,
    statistics: {
      totalWords: sections.reduce((s, sec) => s + sec.wordCount, 0),
      paragraphCount: sections.length,
      estimatedReadTime: `${Math.ceil(sections.reduce((s, sec) => s + sec.wordCount, 0) / 200)} 分钟`
    },
    seo: {
      keywords: [topic, ...template.structure],
      metaDescription: `本文围绕"${topic}"展开，从多个维度进行了深入分析和阐述。`,
      suggestedTags: [topic, type, '原创']
    }
  };

  Logger.info('文章写作完成', { sections: sections.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '文章写作',
  description: '根据主题和要求生成完整文章',
  inputSchema: {
    topic: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '文章主题' },
    type: { type: 'string', required: false, default: 'blog', description: '文章类型' },
    length: { type: 'string', required: false, default: 'medium', description: '篇幅：short|medium|long' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { title: 'string' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    title: 'string',
    sections: 'array',
    fullArticle: 'string',
    statistics: 'object',
    seo: 'object'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：JSON修复
 * 功能：自动修复格式错误的JSON字符串
 */
registry.register('data', 'fixJSON', async (params) => {
  const { input, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始JSON修复', { inputLength: input?.length });

  if (!input) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：input（待修复的JSON字符串）');
  }

  let fixed = input;
  const fixes = [];

  if (typeof input === 'object') {
    return {
      success: true,
      fixedJson: input,
      originalInput: input,
      fixes: [],
      wasValid: true
    };
  }

  fixed = fixed.trim();

  if (fixed.startsWith("'")) {
    fixed = fixed.replace(/'/g, '"');
    fixes.push({ type: 'quote', message: '将单引号替换为双引号' });
  }

  const trailingCommaRegex = /,(\s*[}\]])/g;
  if (trailingCommaRegex.test(fixed)) {
    fixed = fixed.replace(trailingCommaRegex, '$1');
    fixes.push({ type: 'syntax', message: '移除了尾随逗号' });
  }

  const unquotedKeys = /([{,]\s*)(\w+)\s*:/g;
  if (unquotedKeys.test(fixed)) {
    fixed = fixed.replace(unquotedKeys, '$1"$2":');
    fixes.push({ type: 'key', message: '为未加引号的键名添加双引号' });
  }

  const newlinesInStrings = /("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")/g;
  fixed = fixed.replace(newlinesInStrings, (match) =>
    match.replace(/\n/g, '\\n').replace(/\r/g, '\\r')
  );
  if (/[\r\n]/.test(fixed)) {
    fixes.push({ type: 'escape', message: '转义字符串中的换行符' });
  }

  let parsed = Utils.safeParseJSON(fixed);
  if (parsed === null) {
    fixes.push({ type: 'bracket', message: '尝试修复括号匹配' });
    const openBraces = (fixed.match(/\{/g) || []).length;
    const closeBraces = (fixed.match(/\}/g) || []).length;
    const openBrackets = (fixed.match(/\[/g) || []).length;
    const closeBrackets = (fixed.match(/\]/g) || []).length;
    fixed += '}'.repeat(Math.max(0, openBraces - closeBraces));
    fixed += ']'.repeat(Math.max(0, openBrackets - closeBrackets));
    parsed = Utils.safeParseJSON(fixed);
  }

  const result = {
    success: parsed !== null,
    fixedJson: parsed !== null ? parsed : null,
    fixedString: fixed,
    originalInput: input,
    fixes,
    wasAlreadyValid: fixes.length === 0
  };

  Logger.info('JSON修复完成', { fixes: fixes.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: 'JSON修复',
  description: '自动修复格式错误的JSON字符串',
  inputSchema: {
    input: { type: 'string|object', required: true, description: '待修复的JSON' },
    options: { type: 'object', properties: { strict: 'boolean' } }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    fixedJson: 'object|array|null',
    fixes: 'array',
    wasAlreadyValid: 'boolean'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：数据清洗
 * 功能：对数据进行清洗、去重、格式化处理
 */
registry.register('data', 'cleanData', async (params) => {
  const { data, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始数据清洗', { dataType: typeof data });

  if (!data) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：data（待清洗数据）');
  }

  const config = {
    removeDuplicates: options.removeDuplicates ?? true,
    removeEmpty: options.removeEmpty ?? true,
    trimStrings: options.trimStrings ?? true,
    normalizeCase: options.normalizeCase ?? false,
    sortBy: options.sortBy || null,
    filter: options.filter || null
  };

  let cleaned = Array.isArray(data) ? [...data] : [data];
  const changes = [];

  if (config.removeEmpty) {
    const before = cleaned.length;
    cleaned = cleaned.filter(item => {
      if (item === null || item === undefined) return false;
      if (typeof item === 'string' && item.trim() === '') return false;
      if (typeof item === 'object' && Object.keys(item).length === 0) return false;
      return true;
    });
    if (cleaned.length !== before) {
      changes.push(`移除了 ${before - cleaned.length} 条空数据`);
    }
  }

  if (config.trimStrings) {
    cleaned = cleaned.map(item => {
      if (typeof item === 'string') return item.trim();
      if (typeof item === 'object') {
        const result = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(item)) {
          result[k] = typeof v === 'string' ? v.trim() : v;
        }
        return result;
      }
      return item;
    });
    changes.push('已清理所有字符串的首尾空格');
  }

  if (config.normalizeCase) {
    cleaned = cleaned.map(item => {
      if (typeof item === 'string') return item.toLowerCase();
      if (typeof item === 'object') {
        const result = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(item)) {
          result[k] = typeof v === 'string' ? v.toLowerCase() : v;
        }
        return result;
      }
      return item;
    });
    changes.push('已将所有文本转换为小写');
  }

  if (config.removeDuplicates) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const before = cleaned.length;
    cleaned = cleaned.filter(item => {
      const key = typeof item === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(item) : String(item);
      if (seen.has(key)) return false;
      seen.add(key);
      return true;
    });
    if (cleaned.length !== before) {
      changes.push(`移除了 ${before - cleaned.length} 条重复数据`);
    }
  }

  if (config.filter && typeof config.filter === 'function') {
    const before = cleaned.length;
    cleaned = cleaned.filter(config.filter);
    if (cleaned.length !== before) {
      changes.push(`根据过滤器移除了 ${before - cleaned.length} 条数据`);
    }
  }

  if (config.sortBy) {
    const field = config.sortBy;
    const order = options.sortOrder || 'asc';
    cleaned.sort((a, b) => {
      const va = typeof a === 'object' ? a[field] : a;
      const vb = typeof b === 'object' ? b[field] : b;
      if (va < vb) return order === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (va > vb) return order === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });
    changes.push(`按"${field}"字段${order === 'asc' ? '升序' : '降序'}排序`);
  }

  const result = {
    success: true,
    originalCount: Array.isArray(data) ? data.length : 1,
    cleanedCount: cleaned.length,
    removedCount: (Array.isArray(data) ? data.length : 1) - cleaned.length,
    cleanedData: cleaned,
    changes,
    config
  };

  Logger.info('数据清洗完成', { cleaned: cleaned.length });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '数据清洗',
  description: '对数据进行清洗、去重、格式化处理',
  inputSchema: {
    data: { type: 'array|object|string', required: true, description: '待清洗数据' },
    options: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        removeDuplicates: { type: 'boolean' },
        removeEmpty: { type: 'boolean' },
        trimStrings: { type: 'boolean' },
        normalizeCase: { type: 'boolean' },
        sortBy: { type: 'string' },
        sortOrder: { type: 'string' }
      }
    }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    cleanedData: 'array',
    changes: 'array',
    originalCount: 'number',
    cleanedCount: 'number'
  }
});

/**
 * 插件：格式转换
 * 功能：在JSON、CSV、XML、YAML等格式之间进行转换
 */
registry.register('data', 'convertFormat', async (params) => {
  const { input, fromFormat, toFormat, options = {} } = params;
  Logger.info('开始格式转换', { fromFormat, toFormat });

  if (!input) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：input（待转换数据）');
  }
  if (!toFormat) {
    throw new Error('缺少必填参数：toFormat（目标格式）');
  }

  const supportedFormats = ['json', 'csv', 'xml', 'yaml', 'plain-text'];
  if (!supportedFormats.includes(toFormat)) {
    throw new Error(`不支持的目标格式：${toFormat}，可选：${supportedFormats.join(', ')}`);
  }

  let parsedData;
  const sourceFormat = fromFormat || (typeof input === 'object' ? 'json' : 'json');

  if (typeof input === 'object') {
    parsedData = input;
  } else {
    parsedData = Utils.safeParseJSON(input);
    if (parsedData === null) {
      parsedData = { content: String(input) };
    }
  }

  let output;
  switch (toFormat) {
    case 'json':
      output = JSON.stringify(parsedData, null, options.pretty ? 2 : 0);
      break;
    case 'csv':
      output = convertToCSV(parsedData, options);
      break;
    case 'xml':
      output = convertToXML(parsedData, options.rootName || 'root');
      break;
    case 'yaml':
      output = convertToYAML(parsedData);
      break;
    case 'plain-text':
      output = convertToPlainText(parsedData);
      break;
    default:
      output = JSON.stringify(parsedData);
  }

  function convertToCSV(obj, opts) {
    if (!Array.isArray(obj)) {
      if (typeof obj === 'object') obj = [obj];
      else return String(obj);
    }
    if (obj.length === 0) return '';
    const headers = opts.headers || Object.keys(obj[0]);
    const rows = [headers.join(',')];
    for (const item of obj) {
      const row = headers.map(h => {
        const val = item[h];
        if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
        const str = typeof val === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(val) : String(val);
        return str.includes(',') || str.includes('"') || str.includes('\n')
          ? `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
          : str;
      });
      rows.push(row.join(','));
    }
    return rows.join('\n');
  }

  function convertToXML(obj, rootName) {
    function toXml(value, indent = '') {
      if (value === null || value === undefined) return '';
      if (typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
        const parts = [];
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) {
          if (Array.isArray(v)) {
            for (const item of v) {
              parts.push(`${indent}  <${k}>${toXml(item, indent + '    ')}</${k}>`);
            }
          } else if (typeof v === 'object') {
            parts.push(`${indent}  <${k}>${toXml(v, indent + '    ')}</${k}>`);
          } else {
            parts.push(`${indent}  <${k}>${v}</${k}>`);
          }
        }
        return parts.join('\n');
      }
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        return value.map(v => `<item>${toXml(v)}</item>`).join('\n');
      }
      return String(value);
    }
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<${rootName}>\n${toXml(obj, '  ')}\n</${rootName}>`;
  }

  function convertToYAML(obj, indent = 0) {
    const pad = '  '.repeat(indent);
    if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return 'null';
    if (typeof obj !== 'object') {
      if (typeof obj === 'string') {
        return obj.includes(':') || obj.includes('#') || obj.includes('\n')
          ? `"${obj.replace(/"/g, '\\"')}"`
          : obj;
      }
      return String(obj);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      if (obj.length === 0) return '[]';
      return obj.map(item => {
        if (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null) {
          const lines = convertToYAML(item, indent + 1).split('\n');
          return `${pad}- ${lines[0].trim()}\n${lines.slice(1).join('\n')}`;
        }
        return `${pad}- ${convertToYAML(item, indent + 1)}`;
      }).join('\n');
    }
    const entries = Object.entries(obj);
    if (entries.length === 0) return '{}';
    return entries.map(([k, v]) => {
      if (typeof v === 'object' && v !== null) {
        return `${pad}${k}:\n${convertToYAML(v, indent + 1)}`;
      }
      return `${pad}${k}: ${convertToYAML(v, indent + 1)}`;
    }).join('\n');
  }

  function convertToPlainText(obj, indent = 0) {
    const pad = '  '.repeat(indent);
    if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return 'null';
    if (typeof obj === 'object' && !Array.isArray(obj)) {
      return Object.entries(obj)
        .map(([k, v]) => {
          if (typeof v === 'object') return `${pad}${k}:\n${convertToPlainText(v, indent + 1)}`;
          return `${pad}${k}: ${v}`;
        })
        .join('\n');
    }
    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
      return obj.map((item, i) => {
        if (typeof item === 'object') return `${pad}[${i}]:\n${convertToPlainText(item, indent + 1)}`;
        return `${pad}[${i}]: ${item}`;
      }).join('\n');
    }
    return String(obj);
  }

  const result = {
    success: true,
    fromFormat: sourceFormat,
    toFormat,
    output,
    outputType: typeof output,
    size: typeof output === 'string' ? output.length : JSON.stringify(output).length,
    options: { pretty: options.pretty || false }
  };

  Logger.info('格式转换完成', { from: sourceFormat, to: toFormat });
  return result;
}, {
  name: '格式转换',
  description: '在JSON、CSV、XML、YAML等格式之间转换',
  inputSchema: {
    input: { type: 'string|object|array', required: true, description: '待转换数据' },
    fromFormat: { type: 'string', required: false, description: '源格式' },
    toFormat: { type: 'string', required: true, description: '目标格式' },
    options: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        pretty: { type: 'boolean', description: '格式化输出' },
        rootName: { type: 'string', description: 'XML根节点名' },
        headers: { type: 'array', description: 'CSV表头' }
      }
    }
  },
  outputSchema: {
    success: 'boolean',
    output: 'string',
    fromFormat: 'string',
    toFormat: 'string',
    size: 'number'
  }
});

// ============================================================================
// 全局中间件配置
// ============================================================================

registry.use(async (context) => {
  const { config } = context;
  if (config && config.timeout) {
    context.timeout = config.timeout;
  }
  if (config && config.apiKey) {
    context.apiKey = config.apiKey;
  }
  return context;
});

// ============================================================================
// 超级云插件主入口
// ============================================================================

const SuperCloudPlugin = {
  version: PLUGIN_VERSION,
  registry,
  Logger,
  Utils,

  /**
   * 执行指定插件
   * @param {string} category - 插件分类
   * @param {string} action - 插件动作ID
   * @param {object} params - 传递给插件的参数
   * @param {object} config - 全局配置
   * @returns {Promise<object>} 标准化的执行结果
   */
  async execute(category, action, params = {}, config = {}) {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const verbose = config.verbose || false;
    Logger.init(verbose);

    if (verbose) {
      Logger.info('执行开始', { category, action, params });
    }

    try {
      const data = await registry.execute(category, action, params, config);
      const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;

      const result = {
        success: true,
        data,
        executionTime,
        pluginId: `${category}:${action}`,
        action,
        logs: Logger.getLogs()
      };

      Logger.info('执行成功', { executionTime });
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;
      Logger.error('执行失败', { error: error.message, stack: error.stack });

      return {
        success: false,
        data: null,
        error: error.message,
        executionTime,
        pluginId: `${category}:${action}`,
        action,
        logs: Logger.getLogs()
      };
    }
  },

  /**
   * 列出所有已注册插件
   * @param {string} [category] - 可选，按分类过滤
   * @returns {Array} 插件列表
   */
  listPlugins(category) {
    return registry.list(category);
  },

  /**
   * 列出所有插件分类
   * @returns {Array} 分类列表
   */
  listCategories() {
    const categories = new Set();
    for (const plugin of registry.list()) {
      categories.add(plugin.category);
    }
    return Array.from(categories).sort();
  },

  /**
   * 获取插件详情
   * @param {string} category - 插件分类
   * @param {string} action - 插件动作ID
   * @returns {object|null} 插件详情
   */
  getPlugin(category, action) {
    const plugin = registry.resolve(category, action);
    if (!plugin) return null;
    return {
      category: plugin.category,
      id: plugin.id,
      name: plugin.config.name || plugin.id,
      description: plugin.config.description || '',
      inputSchema: plugin.config.inputSchema || {},
      outputSchema: plugin.config.outputSchema || {}
    };
  },

  /**
   * 注册自定义中间件
   * @param {Function} middleware - 中间件函数
   */
  use(middleware) {
    registry.use(middleware);
  },

  /**
   * 动态注册新插件
   * @param {string} category - 插件分类
   * @param {string} id - 插件ID
   * @param {Function} handler - 处理函数
   * @param {object} config - 插件配置
   */
  register(category, id, handler, config) {
    registry.register(category, id, handler, config);
  },

  /**
   * 验证插件参数
   * @param {string} category - 插件分类
   * @param {string} action - 插件动作ID
   * @param {object} params - 待验证参数
   * @returns {object} 验证结果
   */
  validateParams(category, action, params) {
    const plugin = registry.resolve(category, action);
    if (!plugin) {
      return { valid: false, errors: [`插件未找到: ${category}:${action}`] };
    }

    const schema = plugin.config.inputSchema || {};
    const errors = [];

    for (const [key, config] of Object.entries(schema)) {
      if (config.required && (params[key] === undefined || params[key] === null)) {
        errors.push(`缺少必填参数: ${key}`);
      }
      if (params[key] !== undefined && config.type) {
        const typeMap = {
          string: 'string',
          number: 'number',
          boolean: 'boolean',
          object: 'object',
          array: 'object'
        };
        const expectedType = typeMap[config.type];
        if (expectedType && typeof params[key] !== expectedType) {
          if (!(config.type === 'array' && Array.isArray(params[key]))) {
            errors.push(`参数 ${key} 类型错误: 期望 ${config.type}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  },

  /**
   * 批量执行多个插件操作
   * @param {Array} tasks - 任务列表 [{category, action, params, config}]
   * @returns {Promise<Array>} 执行结果列表
   */
  async batchExecute(tasks) {
    if (!Array.isArray(tasks)) {
      throw new Error('tasks必须是数组');
    }
    return Promise.all(tasks.map(task =>
      this.execute(task.category, task.action, task.params, task.config)
    ));
  },

  /**
   * 获取系统信息
   * @returns {object} 系统信息
   */
  getSystemInfo() {
    const plugins = registry.list();
    const categories = {};
    for (const p of plugins) {
      if (!categories[p.category]) categories[p.category] = [];
      categories[p.category].push(p.id);
    }
    return {
      version: PLUGIN_VERSION,
      totalPlugins: plugins.length,
      categories,
      registeredAt: Date.now()
    };
  },

  /**
   * 工具函数引用
   */
  tools: {
    safeParseJSON: Utils.safeParseJSON.bind(Utils),
    deepMerge: Utils.deepMerge.bind(Utils),
    generateId: Utils.generateId.bind(Utils),
    sleep: Utils.sleep.bind(Utils),
    calcSimilarity: Utils.calcSimilarity.bind(Utils),
    truncate: Utils.truncate.bind(Utils),
    extractVideoId: Utils.extractVideoId.bind(Utils),
    detectLanguage: Utils.detectLanguage.bind(Utils),
    analyzeText: Utils.analyzeText.bind(Utils)
  }
};

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
  module.exports = SuperCloudPlugin;
  module.exports.SuperCloudPlugin = SuperCloudPlugin;
  module.exports.default = SuperCloudPlugin;
}

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  window.SuperCloudPlugin = SuperCloudPlugin;
}

/**
 * ============================================================================================
 * 工具介绍
 * ============================================================================================
 * 名称：超级对话流（Super Dialog Flow）
 * 描述：本代码合并了约8个Coze对话流，提供统一的对话管理框架，支持智能客服、代码解答、
 *       内容创作、技术支持、知识问答、创作助手、数据分析、自动化助手等场景。
 *       具备意图识别、多轮对话、上下文管理、情感分析、历史记录等核心能力。
 *
 * 适用场景：
 *   - 智能客服对话流（customer_service）
 *   - 代码问题解答对话流（code_assistant）
 *   - 内容创作对话流（content_creator）
 *   - 技术支持对话流（tech_support）
 *   - 知识问答对话流（knowledge_qa）
 *   - 创作助手对话流（creative_assistant）
 *   - 数据分析对话流（data_analyst）
 *   - 自动化助手对话流（automation_helper）
 *
 * ============================================================================================
 * 输入参数配置
 * ============================================================================================
 * | 参数名          | 类型     | 必填 | 默认值       | 说明                                       |
 * |-----------------|----------|------|-------------|--------------------------------------------|
 * | userInput       | string   | 是   | -           | 用户输入的对话文本                           |
 * | dialogType      | string   | 否   | 'auto'      | 对话流类型标识，'auto'为自动识别            |
 * | userId          | string   | 否   | 'anonymous' | 用户唯一标识，用于会话隔离                   |
 * | sessionId       | string   | 否   | 自动生成     | 会话ID，多轮对话时需保持一致                 |
 * | metadata        | object   | 否   | {}          | 附加元数据（如渠道、设备信息等）             |
 *
 * ============================================================================================
 * 输出参数配置
 * ============================================================================================
 * | 参数名          | 类型     | 说明                                       |
 * |-----------------|----------|--------------------------------------------|
 * | success         | boolean  | 对话处理是否成功                           |
 * | reply           | string   | 生成的回复文本                              |
 * | dialogType      | string   | 实际使用的对话流类型                        |
 * | intent          | string   | 识别出的用户意图                            |
 * | emotion         | string   | 情感分析结果（positive/neutral/negative）  |
 * | suggestions     | array    | 建议的下一步操作/追问                       |
 * | context         | object   | 当前对话上下文快照                          |
 * | tokensUsed      | number   | 本次处理消耗的Token数                       |
 * | timestamp       | string   | 回复生成时间戳                              |
 * ============================================================================================
 */

'use strict';

// =============================================================================================
// 模块一：意图识别引擎
// =============================================================================================
class IntentRecognizer {
  constructor() {
    this.intentPatterns = {
      inquiry: {
        keywords: ['询问', '咨询', '请问', '想问', '了解', '查询', '什么是', '怎么', '如何'],
        weight: 1.0,
      },
      complaint: {
        keywords: ['投诉', '抱怨', '不好', '差', '糟糕', '问题', '故障', '错误', '失败', 'bug'],
        weight: 1.2,
      },
      request: {
        keywords: ['请帮我', '帮忙', '需要', '请求', '帮我', '协助', '能不能', '可以'],
        weight: 0.9,
      },
      feedback: {
        keywords: ['建议', '反馈', '意见', '评价', '体验', '感受', '希望', '应该'],
        weight: 0.8,
      },
      technical: {
        keywords: ['代码', '程序', '函数', 'API', '接口', '报错', '异常', '配置', '安装', '部署', '开发'],
        weight: 1.3,
      },
      creative: {
        keywords: ['写', '创作', '生成', '设计', '构思', '撰写', '编写', '制作', '创意', '文案'],
        weight: 1.1,
      },
      analysis: {
        keywords: ['分析', '统计', '数据', '报表', '趋势', '对比', '指标', '计算', '预测', '图表'],
        weight: 1.0,
      },
      automation: {
        keywords: ['自动化', '脚本', '批量', '定时', '工作流', '流程', '机器人', '执行', '任务'],
        weight: 1.0,
      },
      farewell: {
        keywords: ['再见', '拜拜', '谢谢', '感谢', '结束', '不用了', '退出', '关闭'],
        weight: 0.7,
      },
    };
  }

  recognize(userInput, context = {}) {
    const input = userInput.toLowerCase();
    const scores = {};
    for (const [intent, config] of Object.entries(this.intentPatterns)) {
      let score = 0;
      for (const keyword of config.keywords) {
        if (input.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
          score += config.weight;
        }
      }
      scores[intent] = score;
    }
    if (context.dialogType && context.dialogType !== 'auto') {
      scores[context.dialogType] = (scores[context.dialogType] || 0) + 2.0;
    }
    const sorted = Object.entries(scores).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    return {
      primary: sorted[0][1] > 0 ? sorted[0][0] : 'general',
      scores,
      confidence: sorted[0][1] > 0 ? Math.min(sorted[0][1] / 5, 1) : 0.2,
    };
  }
}

// =============================================================================================
// 模块二：情感分析引擎
// =============================================================================================
class EmotionAnalyzer {
  constructor() {
    this.emotionLexicon = {
      positive: ['好', '棒', '赞', '喜欢', '满意', '开心', '感谢', '优秀', '完美', 'Great', 'nice', 'good', 'awesome', '谢谢', '不错', '厉害', '牛', '赞'],
      negative: ['差', '糟糕', '讨厌', '生气', '失望', '错误', '失败', '垃圾', '坑', '烦', '怒', '糟糕', 'bad', 'terrible', 'worst', 'hate', '问题', '故障', '投诉'],
      neutral: ['嗯', '哦', '好的', '了解', '知道', '继续', '然后', '什么', '怎么'],
    };
    this.intensityModifiers = ['非常', '特别', '真的', '超级', '极其', '太', '很', '非常'];
  }

  analyze(userInput) {
    const input = userInput.toLowerCase();
    let scores = { positive: 0, negative: 0, neutral: 0 };
    for (const [emotion, words] of Object.entries(this.emotionLexicon)) {
      for (const word of words) {
        if (input.includes(word.toLowerCase())) {
          scores[emotion] += 1;
        }
      }
    }
    for (const modifier of this.intensityModifiers) {
      if (input.includes(modifier.toLowerCase())) {
        const maxEmotion = Object.entries(scores).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0][0];
        if (scores[maxEmotion] > 0) {
          scores[maxEmotion] += 0.5;
        }
      }
    }
    const dominant = Object.entries(scores).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
    const total = scores.positive + scores.negative + scores.neutral;
    return {
      emotion: total > 0 ? dominant[0] : 'neutral',
      intensity: total > 0 ? Math.min(dominant[1] / total, 1) : 0.3,
      scores,
    };
  }

  optimizeReply(reply, emotion) {
    let optimized = reply;
    if (emotion.emotion === 'negative' && emotion.intensity > 0.5) {
      const prefixes = [
        '非常抱歉给您带来不好的体验，',
        '理解您的困扰，',
        '对此给您造成的不便，我们深表歉意。',
      ];
      optimized = prefixes[Math.floor(Math.random() * prefixes.length)] + optimized;
    } else if (emotion.emotion === 'positive' && emotion.intensity > 0.5) {
      const suffixes = ['很高兴能帮到您！', '感谢您的认可！', '期待继续为您服务！'];
      optimized = optimized + suffixes[Math.floor(Math.random() * suffixes.length)];
    }
    return optimized;
  }
}

// =============================================================================================
// 模块三：对话历史记录管理
// =============================================================================================
class DialogHistory {
  constructor(maxHistoryLength = 50) {
    this.maxHistoryLength = maxHistoryLength;
    this.sessions = new Map();
  }

  addMessage(sessionId, message) {
    if (!this.sessions.has(sessionId)) {
      this.sessions.set(sessionId, []);
    }
    const history = this.sessions.get(sessionId);
    history.push({
      ...message,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
    if (history.length > this.maxHistoryLength) {
      history.shift();
    }
  }

  getHistory(sessionId, limit = 20) {
    const history = this.sessions.get(sessionId) || [];
    return history.slice(-limit);
  }

  getContextSummary(sessionId) {
    const history = this.sessions.get(sessionId) || [];
    const recent = history.slice(-5);
    return recent.map((m) => ({
      role: m.role,
      content: m.content.slice(0, 100),
    }));
  }

  clearHistory(sessionId) {
    this.sessions.delete(sessionId);
  }

  getSessionStats(sessionId) {
    const history = this.sessions.get(sessionId) || [];
    return {
      messageCount: history.length,
      lastMessage: history[history.length - 1]?.timestamp || null,
      firstMessage: history[0]?.timestamp || null,
    };
  }
}

// =============================================================================================
// 模块四：上下文管理器
// =============================================================================================
class ContextManager {
  constructor() {
    this.contexts = new Map();
  }

  setContext(sessionId, key, value) {
    if (!this.contexts.has(sessionId)) {
      this.contexts.set(sessionId, new Map());
    }
    this.contexts.get(sessionId).set(key, {
      value,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  }

  getContext(sessionId, key) {
    const session = this.contexts.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) return null;
    const entry = session.get(key);
    return entry ? entry.value : null;
  }

  getAllContext(sessionId) {
    const session = this.contexts.get(sessionId);
    if (!session) return {};
    const result = {};
    for (const [key, entry] of session.entries()) {
      result[key] = entry.value;
    }
    return result;
  }

  clearContext(sessionId) {
    this.contexts.delete(sessionId);
  }

  inheritContext(sourceId, targetId, keys) {
    const source = this.contexts.get(sourceId);
    if (!source) return;
    if (!this.contexts.has(targetId)) {
      this.contexts.set(targetId, new Map());
    }
    const target = this.contexts.get(targetId);
    for (const key of keys) {
      if (source.has(key)) {
        target.set(key, source.get(key));
      }
    }
  }
}

      visualization: ['图表', '可视化', '柱状图', '折线图', '饼图', '仪表盘'],

    },
    responseTemplates: {

      ],

      ],
      default: ['请提供需要分析的数据或业务场景描述，我会为您提供专业的数据分析服务。包括但不限于：趋势分析、对比分析、归因分析、预测分析等。'],

  // 8. 自动化助手对话流
  automation_helper: {

// =============================================================================================
// 模块六：超级对话流引擎
// =============================================================================================
class SuperDialogFlowEngine {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.intentRecognizer = new IntentRecognizer();
    this.emotionAnalyzer = new EmotionAnalyzer();
    this.dialogHistory = new DialogHistory();
    this.contextManager = new ContextManager();
    this.configs = DialogFlowConfigs;
    this.defaultDialogType = 'knowledge_qa';
    this.sessionTimeout = 30 * 60 * 1000;
    this.activeSessions = new Map();
  }

  /**
   * 处理用户输入的主入口方法
   * @param {string} userInput - 用户输入文本
   * @param {object} options - 可选配置
   * @returns {object} 处理结果
   */
  processInput(userInput, options = {}) {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    const userId = options.userId || 'anonymous';
    const sessionId = options.sessionId || this._getOrCreateSession(userId);
    const dialogType = options.dialogType || 'auto';
    const metadata = options.metadata || {};

    // 记录用户消息到历史
    this.dialogHistory.addMessage(sessionId, {
      role: 'user',
      content: userInput,
      metadata,
    });

    // 意图识别
    const intentResult = this.intentRecognizer.recognize(userInput, {
      dialogType,
      context: this.contextManager.getAllContext(sessionId),
    });

    // 情感分析
    const emotionResult = this.emotionAnalyzer.analyze(userInput);

    // 确定对话流类型
    const resolvedDialogType = this._resolveDialogType(
      dialogType,
      intentResult.primary,
      userInput
    );

    // 获取对话流配置
    const config = this.configs[resolvedDialogType] || this.configs[this.defaultDialogType];

    // 生成回复
    const replyResult = this._generateReply(
      userInput,
      config,
      resolvedDialogType,
      intentResult,
      emotionResult,
      sessionId
    );

    // 优化回复（基于情感）
    const optimizedReply = this.emotionAnalyzer.optimizeReply(
      replyResult.reply,
      emotionResult
    );

    // 记录助手回复到历史
    this.dialogHistory.addMessage(sessionId, {
      role: 'assistant',
      content: optimizedReply,
      dialogType: resolvedDialogType,
      intent: intentResult.primary,
    });

    // 更新上下文
    this._updateContext(sessionId, {
      lastIntent: intentResult.primary,
      lastEmotion: emotionResult.emotion,
      lastDialogType: resolvedDialogType,
      interactionCount: (this.contextManager.getContext(sessionId, 'interactionCount') || 0) + 1,
    });

    const tokensUsed = this._estimateTokens(userInput + optimizedReply);
    const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;

    return {
      success: true,
      reply: optimizedReply,
      dialogType: resolvedDialogType,
      intent: intentResult.primary,
      emotion: emotionResult.emotion,
      suggestions: replyResult.suggestions,
      context: this.contextManager.getAllContext(sessionId),
      tokensUsed,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      sessionId,
      processingTime: elapsed,
    };
  }

  /**
   * 获取人设问候语
   * @param {string} dialogType - 对话流类型
   * @returns {string} 问候语
   */
  getGreeting(dialogType = null) {
    const type = dialogType || this.defaultDialogType;
    const config = this.configs[type];
    return config?.persona?.greeting || '您好，很高兴为您服务！';
  }

  /**
   * 获取对话流列表
   * @returns {Array} 对话流信息列表
   */
  getAvailableDialogs() {
    return Object.entries(this.configs).map(([key, config]) => ({
      key,
      name: config.name,
      persona: {
        name: config.persona.name,
        role: config.persona.role,
        traits: config.persona.traits,
      },
    }));
  }

  /**
   * 获取会话历史
   * @param {string} sessionId - 会话ID
   * @param {number} limit - 返回条数限制
   * @returns {Array} 对话历史
   */
  getSessionHistory(sessionId, limit = 20) {
    return this.dialogHistory.getHistory(sessionId, limit);
  }

  /**
   * 清除会话
   * @param {string} sessionId - 会话ID
   */
  clearSession(sessionId) {
    this.dialogHistory.clearHistory(sessionId);
    this.contextManager.clearContext(sessionId);
    this.activeSessions.delete(sessionId);
  }

  // ============================================================================================
  // 私有方法
  // ============================================================================================

  _getOrCreateSession(userId) {
    for (const [sessionId, data] of this.activeSessions.entries()) {
      if (data.userId === userId && Date.now() - data.lastActive < this.sessionTimeout) {
        return sessionId;
      }
    }
    const newSessionId = `session_${userId}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
    this.activeSessions.set(newSessionId, {
      userId,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      lastActive: Date.now(),
    });
    return newSessionId;
  }

  _resolveDialogType(requestedType, intent, userInput) {
    if (requestedType !== 'auto' && this.configs[requestedType]) {
      return requestedType;
    }
    const input = userInput.toLowerCase();
    const typeMapping = {
      inquiry: 'customer_service',
      complaint: 'customer_service',
      request: this._detectRequestType(input),
      feedback: 'customer_service',
      technical: 'tech_support',
      creative: 'content_creator',
      analysis: 'data_analyst',
      automation: 'automation_helper',
      farewell: 'knowledge_qa',
      general: this._detectGeneralType(input),
    };
    return typeMapping[intent] || this.defaultDialogType;
  }

  _detectRequestType(input) {
    const typeScores = {
      code_assistant: 0,
      creative_assistant: 0,
      content_creator: 0,
      tech_support: 0,
      knowledge_qa: 0,
      data_analyst: 0,
      automation_helper: 0,
      customer_service: 0,
    };
    const configs = this.configs;
    for (const [type, config] of Object.entries(configs)) {
      for (const keywords of Object.values(config.knowledge)) {
        for (const keyword of keywords) {
          if (input.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
            typeScores[type] += 1;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const sorted = Object.entries(typeScores).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    return sorted[0][1] > 0 ? sorted[0][0] : this.defaultDialogType;
  }

  _detectGeneralType(input) {
    return this.defaultDialogType;
  }

  _generateReply(userInput, config, dialogType, intentResult, emotionResult, sessionId) {
    const input = userInput.toLowerCase();
    let matchedCategory = null;
    let matchScore = 0;

    for (const [category, keywords] of Object.entries(config.knowledge)) {
      if (Array.isArray(keywords)) {
        let score = 0;
        for (const keyword of keywords) {
          if (input.includes(keyword.toLowerCase())) {
            score += 1;
          }
        }
        if (score > matchScore) {
          matchScore = score;
          matchedCategory = category;
        }
      }
    }

    let replyTemplates;
    if (matchedCategory && config.responseTemplates[matchedCategory]) {
      replyTemplates = config.responseTemplates[matchedCategory];
    } else {
      replyTemplates = config.responseTemplates.default;
    }

    const reply = replyTemplates[Math.floor(Math.random() * replyTemplates.length)];
    const suggestions = this._generateSuggestions(dialogType, matchedCategory);

    return {
      reply,
      suggestions,
      matchedCategory,
    };
  }

  _generateSuggestions(dialogType, matchedCategory) {
    const suggestionPool = {
      customer_service: [
        '您可以提供订单号以便查询',
        '需要我为您介绍更多产品信息吗？',
        '是否需要转接人工客服？',
        '还有其他问题需要咨询吗？',
      ],
      code_assistant: [
        '需要我提供完整的代码实现吗？',
        '是否需要了解更多相关API的用法？',
        '要不要我推荐一些学习资料？',
        '需要我帮您优化现有代码吗？',
      ],
      content_creator: [
        '需要我调整内容风格吗？',
        '是否需要更长或更短的版本？',
        '要不要尝试其他创作角度？',
        '需要我生成更多变体吗？',
      ],
      tech_support: [
        '问题解决了吗？',
        '需要我协助远程排查吗？',
        '是否需要查看相关文档？',
        '还有其他技术问题吗？',
      ],
      knowledge_qa: [
        '需要我深入讲解某个方面吗？',
        '是否需要相关的推荐阅读？',
        '要不要了解更多细节？',
        '还有其他想了解的知识吗？',
      ],
      creative_assistant: [
        '需要我提供更多创意方向吗？',
        '是否希望我详细展开某个方案？',
        '要不要尝试完全不同的风格？',
        '灵感是否找到了？',
      ],
      data_analyst: [
        '需要我进行更深入的分析吗？',
        '是否需要可视化图表建议？',
        '要不要探索其他分析角度？',
        '需要我提供具体的数据模型吗？',
      ],
      automation_helper: [
        '需要我帮您编写完整的自动化脚本吗？',
        '是否需要集成到现有系统中？',
        '要不要设计更复杂的工作流？',
        '需要我提供监控告警方案吗？',
      ],
    };
    const pool = suggestionPool[dialogType] || suggestionPool.customer_service;
    return pool.slice(0, 3);
  }

  _updateContext(sessionId, updates) {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(updates)) {
      this.contextManager.setContext(sessionId, key, value);
    }
  }

  _estimateTokens(text) {
    const charCount = text.length;
    return Math.ceil(charCount / 2);
  }
}

// =============================================================================================
// 模块七：快捷使用接口
// =============================================================================================

/**
 * 创建超级对话流引擎实例
 * @param {object} options - 配置选项
 * @returns {SuperDialogFlowEngine} 引擎实例
 */
function createEngine(options = {}) {
  return new SuperDialogFlowEngine(options);
}

/**
 * 快捷对话处理（创建一次性引擎处理单次对话）
 * @param {string} userInput - 用户输入
 * @param {object} options - 配置选项
 * @returns {object} 处理结果
 */
function quickChat(userInput, options = {}) {
  const engine = createEngine(options);
  return engine.processInput(userInput, options);
}

// =============================================================================================
// 模块八：示例演示
// =============================================================================================
function runDemo() {
  console.log('='.repeat(60));
  console.log('超级对话流引擎 - 功能演示');
  console.log('='.repeat(60));

  const engine = createEngine();

  // 演示1：智能客服
  console.log('\n【演示1：智能客服对话流】');
  console.log(engine.processInput('我想查询一下我的订单状态', { dialogType: 'customer_service' }));

  // 演示2：代码解答
  console.log('\n【演示2：代码问题解答对话流】');
  console.log(engine.processInput('这段JavaScript代码报错了怎么调试', { dialogType: 'code_assistant' }));

  // 演示3：内容创作
  console.log('\n【演示3：内容创作对话流】');
  console.log(engine.processInput('帮我写一篇关于人工智能的文章', { dialogType: 'content_creator' }));

  // 演示4：自动识别
  console.log('\n【演示4：自动识别对话流】');
  console.log(engine.processInput('我想分析一下销售数据的趋势'));

  // 演示5：多轮对话
  console.log('\n【演示5：多轮对话演示】');
  const sessionId = 'demo_session_001';
  const responses = [
    engine.processInput('你好', { sessionId }),
    engine.processInput('帮我分析最近的销售数据', { sessionId }),
    engine.processInput('那趋势如何呢？', { sessionId }),
  ];
  responses.forEach((r, i) => {
    console.log(`\n第${i + 1}轮回复：`);
    console.log(`  类型：${r.dialogType}`);
    console.log(`  意图：${r.intent}`);
    console.log(`  情感：${r.emotion}`);
    console.log(`  回复：${r.reply.slice(0, 80)}...`);
  });

  console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(60));
  console.log('所有对话流演示完成！');
  console.log('='.repeat(60));
}

}
