'use strict';

const crypto = require('crypto');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { EventEmitter } = require('events');

const ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES = [
  '.txt', '.md', '.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.xls', '.xlsx',
  '.ppt', '.pptx', '.csv', '.json', '.html', '.xml', '.rtf'
];

// ============================================================================
// 1. 缓存管理器 - 基础缓存机制，优化性能
// ============================================================================
class CacheManager {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.maxSize = options.maxSize || 1000;
    this.ttl = options.ttl || 3600;
    this.cache = new Map();
    this.stats = { hits: 0, misses: 0, evictions: 0 };
  }

  get(key) {
    const entry = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!entry) { this.stats.misses++; return null; }
    if (Date.now() > entry.expireAt) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      this.stats.evictions++;
      this.stats.misses++;
      return null;
    }
    this.cache.delete(key);
    this.cache.set(key, entry);
    this.stats.hits++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key, value, ttl = null) {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize) {
      const firstKey = this.cache.keys().next().value;
      this.cache.delete(firstKey);
      this.stats.evictions++;
    }
    this.cache.set(key, {
      value,
      expireAt: Date.now() + (ttl || this.ttl) * 1000,
      createdAt: Date.now()
    });
  }

  has(key) { return this.get(key) !== null; }
  delete(key) { return this.cache.delete(key); }
  clear() { this.cache.clear(); this.stats = { hits: 0, misses: 0, evictions: 0 }; }
  getStats() { return { ...this.stats, size: this.cache.size, hitRate: this.stats.hits / (this.stats.hits + this.stats.misses || 1) }; }
}

// ============================================================================
// 2. 验证工具 - 数据验证和错误处理
// ============================================================================
class Validator {
  static validateString(value, name, { required = false, min = 0, max = 1000 } = {}) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) {
      if (required) throw new ValidationError(`${name}不能为空`);
      return '';
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new ValidationError(`${name}必须为字符串`);
    if (value.length < min) throw new ValidationError(`${name}长度不能少于${min}`);
    if (value.length > max) throw new ValidationError(`${name}长度不能超过${max}`);
    return value.trim();
  }

  static validateArray(value, name, { required = false, min = 0, max = 10000 } = {}) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) {
      if (required) throw new ValidationError(`${name}不能为空`);
      return [];
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new ValidationError(`${name}必须为数组`);
    if (value.length < min) throw new ValidationError(`${name}长度不能少于${min}`);
    if (value.length > max) throw new ValidationError(`${name}长度不能超过${max}`);
    return value;
  }

  static validateObject(value, name, { required = false } = {}) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) {
      if (required) throw new ValidationError(`${name}不能为空`);
      return {};
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) throw new ValidationError(`${name}必须为对象`);
    return value;
  }

  static validateNumber(value, name, { required = false, min = -Infinity, max = Infinity } = {}) {
    if (value === undefined || value === null) {
      if (required) throw new ValidationError(`${name}不能为空`);
      return 0;
    }
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || isNaN(value)) throw new ValidationError(`${name}必须为数字`);
    if (value < min || value > max) throw new ValidationError(`${name}必须在${min}到${max}之间`);
    return value;
  }

  static validateFile(file, { allowedTypes = ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES, maxSize = 10485760 } = {}) {
    if (!file || !file.path) throw new ValidationError('文件路径不能为空');
    if (!fs.existsSync(file.path)) throw new ValidationError(`文件不存在: ${file.path}`);
    const ext = path.extname(file.path).toLowerCase();
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(ext)) throw new ValidationError(`不支持的文件类型: ${ext}`);
    const stat = fs.statSync(file.path);
    if (stat.size > maxSize) throw new ValidationError(`文件超过最大限制: ${maxSize}字节`);
    return { path: file.path, name: path.basename(file.path), size: stat.size, type: ext };
  }
}

class ValidationError extends Error {
  constructor(message) { super(message); this.name = 'ValidationError'; this.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR'; }
}

class KnowledgeError extends Error {
  constructor(message, code = 'UNKNOWN_ERROR') { super(message); this.name = 'KnowledgeError'; this.code = code; }
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. 日志工具
// ============================================================================
class Logger {
  constructor(enabled = true) { this.enabled = enabled; this.logs = []; }
  log(level, module, message, data = null) {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    const entry = { level, module, message, data, timestamp: Date.now() };
    this.logs.push(entry);
    if (this.logs.length > 10000) this.logs.shift();
    const prefix = `[${level.toUpperCase()}] [${module}]`;
    console.log(`${prefix} ${message}`);
    if (data && level === 'debug') console.log(data);
  }
  info(module, msg, data) { this.log('info', module, msg, data); }
  warn(module, msg, data) { this.log('warn', module, msg, data); }
  error(module, msg, data) { this.log('error', module, msg, data); }
  debug(module, msg, data) { this.log('debug', module, msg, data); }
  getLogs(level = null) { return level ? this.logs.filter(l => l.level === level) : this.logs; }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块一：知识库上传管理
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeUploadManager {
  constructor(config = {}, logger, cache) {
    this.config = config;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.uploadQueue = [];
    this.parsedFiles = new Map();
  }

  async batchUpload(files) {
    try {
      const validated = Validator.validateArray(files, 'files', { required: true });
      const results = [];
      for (const file of validated) {
        try {
          const fileInfo = Validator.validateFile(file, {
            allowedTypes: this.config.allowedTypes,
            maxSize: this.config.maxFileSize
          });
          const parsed = await this.parseFile(fileInfo);
          const converted = await this.convertFormat(parsed);
          results.push({ success: true, file: fileInfo, parsed: converted });
          this.logger.info('Upload', `上传成功: ${fileInfo.name}`);
        } catch (err) {
          results.push({ success: false, file: file, error: err.message });
          this.logger.error('Upload', `上传失败: ${err.message}`);
        }
      }
      return this._response(0, '批量上传完成', { results, total: results.length, successCount: results.filter(r => r.success).length });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'UPLOAD_BATCH_ERROR');
    }
  }

  async parseFile(fileInfo) {
    const cacheKey = `parse:${fileInfo.path}:${fileInfo.size}`;
    const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const ext = fileInfo.type;
    const content = await this._extractContent(fileInfo.path, ext);
    const parsed = {
      id: this._generateId(),
      name: fileInfo.name,
      path: fileInfo.path,
      size: fileInfo.size,
      type: ext,
      content,
      chunks: this._chunkContent(content),
      parsedAt: Date.now()
    };
    this.cache.set(cacheKey, parsed);
    this.parsedFiles.set(parsed.id, parsed);
    return parsed;
  }

  async convertFormat(parsedData) {
    return {
      id: parsedData.id,
      metadata: {
        name: parsedData.name,
        type: parsedData.type,
        size: parsedData.size,
        uploadedAt: parsedData.parsedAt,
        chunkCount: parsedData.chunks.length
      },
      chunks: parsedData.chunks.map((chunk, idx) => ({
        id: `${parsedData.id}_${idx}`,
        index: idx,
        content: chunk,
        tokens: chunk.length
      }))
    };
  }

  async _extractContent(filePath, ext) {
    try {
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
      return raw;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(`文件解析失败: ${err.message}`, 'PARSE_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _chunkContent(content, maxChunkSize = 500) {
    const chunks = [];
    if (!content) return chunks;
    const sentences = content.split(/(?<=[。！？.!?\n])/);
    let currentChunk = '';
    for (const sentence of sentences) {
      if ((currentChunk + sentence).length > maxChunkSize) {
        if (currentChunk) chunks.push(currentChunk.trim());
        currentChunk = sentence;
      } else {
        currentChunk += sentence;
      }
    }
    if (currentChunk.trim()) chunks.push(currentChunk.trim());
    return chunks;
  }

  _generateId() {
    return `kb_${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex')}`;
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: this._generateId() };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块二：知识库索引构建
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeIndexBuilder {
  constructor(config = {}, logger, cache) {
    this.config = config;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.forwardIndex = new Map();
    this.invertedIndex = new Map();
    this.keywordIndex = new Map();
    this.semanticIndex = new Map();
    this.docLengths = new Map();
    this.avgDocLength = 0;
    this.docCount = 0;
  }

  buildIndex(documents) {
    try {
      const docs = Validator.validateArray(documents, 'documents', { required: true });
      let totalLength = 0;
      for (const doc of docs) {
        this._indexDocument(doc);
        totalLength += doc.content ? doc.content.length : 0;
      }
      this.docCount = docs.length;
      this.avgDocLength = this.docCount > 0 ? totalLength / this.docCount : 0;
      this._saveIndex();
      this.logger.info('Index', `索引构建完成: ${this.docCount}个文档`);
      return this._response(0, '索引构建成功', {
        docCount: this.docCount,
        avgDocLength: this.avgDocLength,
        indexSize: this.forwardIndex.size,
        shards: this._getShardInfo()
      });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'INDEX_BUILD_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _indexDocument(doc) {
    const terms = this._tokenize(doc.content || '');
    this.forwardIndex.set(doc.id, {
      id: doc.id,
      content: doc.content,
      metadata: doc.metadata || {},
      terms,
      indexedAt: Date.now()
    });
    this.docLengths.set(doc.id, terms.length);
    for (const term of terms) {
      if (!this.invertedIndex.has(term)) this.invertedIndex.set(term, new Map());
      const docMap = this.invertedIndex.get(term);
      docMap.set(doc.id, (docMap.get(doc.id) || 0) + 1);
      if (!this.keywordIndex.has(term)) this.keywordIndex.set(term, { df: 0, postings: new Map() });
      this.keywordIndex.get(term).df++;
      this.keywordIndex.get(term).postings.set(doc.id, (this.keywordIndex.get(term).postings.get(doc.id) || 0) + 1);
    }
    if (doc.metadata && doc.metadata.keywords) {
      for (const kw of doc.metadata.keywords) {
        if (!this.keywordIndex.has(kw)) this.keywordIndex.set(kw, { df: 0, postings: new Map() });
        this.keywordIndex.get(kw).df++;
        this.keywordIndex.get(kw).postings.set(doc.id, 1);
      }
    }
    const vector = this._computeVector(doc.id, terms);
    this.semanticIndex.set(doc.id, { vector, terms });
  }

  _tokenize(text) {
    if (!text) return [];
    const tokens = [];
    const chineseChars = text.match(/[\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g) || [];
    const englishWords = text.match(/[a-zA-Z]+/g) || [];
    const numbers = text.match(/\d+/g) || [];
    tokens.push(...chineseChars, ...englishWords.map(w => w.toLowerCase()), ...numbers);
    return tokens;
  }

  _computeVector(docId, terms) {
    const dimensions = 128;
    const vector = new Array(dimensions).fill(0);
    for (const term of terms) {
      let hash = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < term.length; i++) {
        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash + term.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
      }
      const idx = Math.abs(hash) % dimensions;
      vector[idx] += 1;
    }
    const norm = Math.sqrt(vector.reduce((s, v) => s + v * v, 0));
    return vector.map(v => norm > 0 ? v / norm : 0);
  }

  _getShardInfo() {
    return [{ id: 0, docCount: this.docCount, indexSize: this.forwardIndex.size }];
  }

  _saveIndex() {
    if (!this.config.indexPath) return;
    try {
      const indexData = {
        forwardIndex: Array.from(this.forwardIndex.entries()),
        invertedIndex: Array.from(this.invertedIndex.entries()),
        docCount: this.docCount,
        avgDocLength: this.avgDocLength,
        savedAt: Date.now()
      };
      fs.mkdirSync(this.config.indexPath, { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(this.config.indexPath, 'index.json'), JSON.stringify(indexData));
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.warn('Index', `索引保存失败: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块三：知识库搜索查询
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeSearchEngine {
  constructor(indexBuilder, logger, cache) {
    this.indexBuilder = indexBuilder;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
  }

  keywordSearch(query, options = {}) {
    try {
      const q = Validator.validateString(query, 'query', { required: true, min: 1 });
      const { limit = 10, offset = 0, minScore = 0 } = options;
      const cacheKey = `kw:${q}:${limit}:${offset}`;
      const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) return cached;
      const terms = this.indexBuilder._tokenize(q);
      const scores = new Map();
      for (const term of terms) {
        const postings = this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term);
        if (!postings) continue;
        const df = postings.df;
        const idf = Math.log((this.indexBuilder.docCount - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1);
        postings.postings.forEach((tf, docId) => {
          const docLen = this.indexBuilder.docLengths.get(docId) || 1;
          const score = idf * (tf * (1.5 + 1)) / (tf + 1.5 * (1 - 0.75) + 0.75 * (docLen / this.indexBuilder.avgDocLength));
          scores.set(docId, (scores.get(docId) || 0) + score);
        });
      }
      const results = Array.from(scores.entries())
        .filter(([, s]) => s >= minScore)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
        .slice(offset, offset + limit)
        .map(([docId, score]) => this._buildResult(docId, score, 'keyword'));
      const response = this._response(0, '关键词搜索完成', { total: results.length, items: results });
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, response);
      return response;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'KEYWORD_SEARCH_ERROR');
    }
  }

  semanticSearch(query, options = {}) {
    try {
      const q = Validator.validateString(query, 'query', { required: true, min: 1 });
      const { limit = 10, threshold = 0.3 } = options;
      const cacheKey = `sem:${q}:${limit}`;
      const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) return cached;
      const terms = this.indexBuilder._tokenize(q);
      const queryVector = this.indexBuilder._computeVector('query', terms);
      const results = [];
      this.indexBuilder.semanticIndex.forEach((data, docId) => {
        const similarity = this._cosineSimilarity(queryVector, data.vector);
        if (similarity >= threshold) {
          results.push(this._buildResult(docId, similarity, 'semantic'));
        }
      });
      results.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
      const response = this._response(0, '语义搜索完成', { total: results.length, items: results.slice(0, limit) });
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, response);
      return response;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'SEMANTIC_SEARCH_ERROR');
    }
  }

  hybridSearch(query, options = {}) {
    try {
      const q = Validator.validateString(query, 'query', { required: true, min: 1 });
      const { limit = 10, keywordWeight = 0.4, semanticWeight = 0.6 } = options;
      const cacheKey = `hyb:${q}:${limit}:${keywordWeight}:${semanticWeight}`;
      const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) return cached;
      const kwResults = this.keywordSearch(q, { limit: limit * 2 }).data.items;
      const semResults = this.semanticSearch(q, { limit: limit * 2 }).data.items;
      const merged = new Map();
      kwResults.forEach(r => {
        merged.set(r.id, { ...r, score: r.score * keywordWeight });
      });
      semResults.forEach(r => {
        if (merged.has(r.id)) {
          const existing = merged.get(r.id);
          existing.score += r.score * semanticWeight;
          existing.matchTypes.push('semantic');
        } else {
          merged.set(r.id, { ...r, score: r.score * semanticWeight, matchTypes: ['semantic'] });
        }
      });
      const results = Array.from(merged.values()).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, limit);
      const response = this._response(0, '混合搜索完成', { total: results.length, items: results });
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, response);
      return response;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'HYBRID_SEARCH_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _cosineSimilarity(vecA, vecB) {
    let dot = 0, normA = 0, normB = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < vecA.length; i++) {
      dot += vecA[i] * vecB[i];
      normA += vecA[i] * vecA[i];
      normB += vecB[i] * vecB[i];
    }
    return normA > 0 && normB > 0 ? dot / (Math.sqrt(normA) * Math.sqrt(normB)) : 0;
  }

  _buildResult(docId, score, matchType) {
    const doc = this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.get(docId);
    if (!doc) return null;
    const matchTypes = matchType ? [matchType] : [];
    const content = doc.content.length > 200 ? doc.content.substring(0, 200) + '...' : doc.content;
    return { id: docId, score: parseFloat(score.toFixed(4)), content, metadata: doc.metadata, matchTypes };
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块四：知识库内容管理
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeContentManager {
  constructor(indexBuilder, logger, cache) {
    this.indexBuilder = indexBuilder;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.versions = new Map();
    this.history = [];
  }

  addDocument(document) {
    try {
      const doc = Validator.validateObject(document, 'document', { required: true });
      doc.id = doc.id || `doc_${crypto.randomBytes(12).toString('hex')}`;
      doc.version = 1;
      doc.createdAt = Date.now();
      doc.updatedAt = Date.now();
      this._saveVersion(doc);
      this._recordHistory('add', doc.id, doc);
      const terms = this.indexBuilder._tokenize(doc.content || '');
      this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.set(doc.id, {
        id: doc.id,
        content: doc.content,
        metadata: doc.metadata || {},
        terms,
        version: doc.version,
        createdAt: doc.createdAt,
        updatedAt: doc.updatedAt,
        indexedAt: Date.now()
      });
      this.indexBuilder.docLengths.set(doc.id, terms.length);
      for (const term of terms) {
        if (!this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.has(term)) this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.set(term, new Map());
        const docMap = this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.get(term);
        docMap.set(doc.id, (docMap.get(doc.id) || 0) + 1);
        if (!this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.has(term)) this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.set(term, { df: 0, postings: new Map() });
        this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term).df++;
        this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term).postings.set(doc.id, (this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term).postings.get(doc.id) || 0) + 1);
      }
      if (doc.metadata && doc.metadata.keywords) {
        for (const kw of doc.metadata.keywords) {
          if (!this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.has(kw)) this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.set(kw, { df: 0, postings: new Map() });
          this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(kw).df++;
          this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(kw).postings.set(doc.id, 1);
        }
      }
      const vector = this.indexBuilder._computeVector(doc.id, terms);
      this.indexBuilder.semanticIndex.set(doc.id, { vector, terms });
      this.indexBuilder.docCount++;
      this.logger.info('Content', `添加文档: ${doc.id}`);
      return this._response(0, '文档添加成功', { document: doc });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'DOC_ADD_ERROR');
    }
  }

  getDocument(id) {
    try {
      const docId = Validator.validateString(id, 'id', { required: true });
      const doc = this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.get(docId);
      if (!doc) throw new KnowledgeError(`文档不存在: ${docId}`, 'DOC_NOT_FOUND');
      return this._response(0, '文档获取成功', { document: doc });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'DOC_GET_ERROR');
    }
  }

  updateDocument(id, updates) {
    try {
      const docId = Validator.validateString(id, 'id', { required: true });
      const doc = this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.get(docId);
      if (!doc) throw new KnowledgeError(`文档不存在: ${docId}`, 'DOC_NOT_FOUND');
      this._saveVersion(doc);
      for (const term of (doc.terms || [])) {
        const posting = this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term);
        if (posting) {
          posting.postings.delete(docId);
          posting.df = Math.max(0, posting.df - 1);
          if (posting.df === 0) this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.delete(term);
        }
        const invMap = this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.get(term);
        if (invMap) {
          invMap.delete(docId);
          if (invMap.size === 0) this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.delete(term);
        }
      }
      const updated = { ...doc, ...updates, version: (doc.version || 1) + 1, updatedAt: Date.now() };
      const newTerms = this.indexBuilder._tokenize(updated.content || '');
      updated.terms = newTerms;
      this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.set(docId, updated);
      this.indexBuilder.docLengths.set(docId, newTerms.length);
      for (const term of newTerms) {
        if (!this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.has(term)) this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.set(term, new Map());
        const docMap = this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.get(term);
        docMap.set(docId, (docMap.get(docId) || 0) + 1);
        if (!this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.has(term)) this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.set(term, { df: 0, postings: new Map() });
        this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term).df++;
        this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term).postings.set(docId, (this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term).postings.get(docId) || 0) + 1);
      }
      if (updated.metadata && updated.metadata.keywords) {
        for (const kw of updated.metadata.keywords) {
          if (!this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.has(kw)) this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.set(kw, { df: 0, postings: new Map() });
          this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(kw).df++;
          this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(kw).postings.set(docId, 1);
        }
      }
      const vector = this.indexBuilder._computeVector(docId, newTerms);
      this.indexBuilder.semanticIndex.set(docId, { vector, terms: newTerms });
      this._recordHistory('update', docId, { previousVersion: doc.version, newVersion: updated.version });
      this.cache.delete(`doc:${docId}`);
      this.logger.info('Content', `更新文档: ${docId}, 版本: ${updated.version}`);
      return this._response(0, '文档更新成功', { document: updated });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'DOC_UPDATE_ERROR');
    }
  }

  deleteDocument(id) {
    try {
      const docId = Validator.validateString(id, 'id', { required: true });
      const doc = this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.get(docId);
      if (!doc) throw new KnowledgeError(`文档不存在: ${docId}`, 'DOC_NOT_FOUND');
      this._saveVersion(doc);
      for (const term of (doc.terms || [])) {
        const posting = this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(term);
        if (posting) {
          posting.postings.delete(docId);
          posting.df = Math.max(0, posting.df - 1);
          if (posting.df === 0) this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.delete(term);
        }
        const invMap = this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.get(term);
        if (invMap) {
          invMap.delete(docId);
          if (invMap.size === 0) this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.delete(term);
        }
      }
      if (doc.metadata && doc.metadata.keywords) {
        for (const kw of doc.metadata.keywords) {
          const posting = this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.get(kw);
          if (posting) {
            posting.postings.delete(docId);
            posting.df = Math.max(0, posting.df - 1);
            if (posting.df === 0) this.indexBuilder.keywordIndex.delete(kw);
          }
        }
      }
      this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.delete(docId);
      this.indexBuilder.docLengths.delete(docId);
      this.indexBuilder.semanticIndex.delete(docId);
      this.indexBuilder.docCount = Math.max(0, this.indexBuilder.docCount - 1);
      this._recordHistory('delete', docId, doc);
      this.cache.delete(`doc:${docId}`);
      this.logger.info('Content', `删除文档: ${docId}`);
      return this._response(0, '文档删除成功', { id: docId });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'DOC_DELETE_ERROR');
    }
  }

  getVersionHistory(id) {
    try {
      const docId = Validator.validateString(id, 'id', { required: true });
      const versions = this.versions.get(docId) || [];
      return this._response(0, '版本历史获取成功', { id: docId, versions: versions.length, history: versions.map(v => ({ version: v.version, timestamp: v.updatedAt, size: v.content ? v.content.length : 0 })) });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'VERSION_HISTORY_ERROR');
    }
  }

  rollbackVersion(id, targetVersion) {
    try {
      const docId = Validator.validateString(id, 'id', { required: true });
      const ver = Validator.validateNumber(targetVersion, 'targetVersion', { required: true, min: 1 });
      const versions = this.versions.get(docId) || [];
      const target = versions.find(v => v.version === ver);
      if (!target) throw new KnowledgeError(`版本不存在: ${ver}`, 'VERSION_NOT_FOUND');
      target.version = (target.version || 1) + 1;
      target.updatedAt = Date.now();
      this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.set(docId, target);
      this._recordHistory('rollback', docId, { targetVersion: ver });
      this.logger.info('Content', `回滚版本: ${docId} -> v${ver}`);
      return this._response(0, '版本回滚成功', { document: target });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'ROLLBACK_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _saveVersion(doc) {
    if (!this.versions.has(doc.id)) this.versions.set(doc.id, []);
    const versions = this.versions.get(doc.id);
    versions.push({ ...doc });
    if (versions.length > 10) versions.shift();
  }

  _recordHistory(action, docId, detail) {
    this.history.push({ action, docId, detail, timestamp: Date.now() });
    if (this.history.length > 5000) this.history.shift();
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块五：知识库质量评估
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeQualityAssessor {
  constructor(indexBuilder, logger, cache) {
    this.indexBuilder = indexBuilder;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.assessmentRules = {
      minContentLength: 10,
      maxContentLength: 100000,
      completenessWeight: 0.4,
      consistencyWeight: 0.3,
      qualityWeight: 0.3
    };
  }

  assessQuality(docId) {
    try {
      const doc = this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.get(docId);
      if (!doc) throw new KnowledgeError(`文档不存在: ${docId}`, 'DOC_NOT_FOUND');
      const cacheKey = `quality:${docId}`;
      const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) return cached;
      const completeness = this._checkCompleteness(doc);
      const consistency = this._checkConsistency(doc);
      const quality = this._checkQuality(doc);
      const score = Math.round((completeness.score * this.assessmentRules.completenessWeight + consistency.score * this.assessmentRules.consistencyWeight + quality.score * this.assessmentRules.qualityWeight) * 100) / 100;
      const report = {
        id: docId,
        score,
        completeness,
        consistency,
        quality,
        issues: [...completeness.issues, ...consistency.issues, ...quality.issues],
        assessedAt: Date.now()
      };
      const response = this._response(0, '质量评估完成', report);
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, response);
      this.logger.info('Quality', `文档质量评分: ${docId} = ${score}`);
      return response;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'QUALITY_ASSESS_ERROR');
    }
  }

  batchAssessQuality(docIds) {
    try {
      const ids = Validator.validateArray(docIds, 'docIds', { required: true });
      const results = [];
      for (const id of ids) {
        try { results.push(this.assessQuality(id)); }
        catch (err) { results.push({ code: 1, message: err.message, data: { id, error: err.message } }); }
      }
      const avgScore = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.data.score || 0), 0) / (results.length || 1);
      return this._response(0, '批量评估完成', {
        total: results.length,
        averageScore: parseFloat(avgScore.toFixed(2)),
        items: results
      });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'BATCH_ASSESS_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _checkCompleteness(doc) {
    const issues = [];
    let score = 1.0;
    if (!doc.content || doc.content.length < this.assessmentRules.minContentLength) {
      issues.push('内容过短或为空');
      score -= 0.4;
    }
    if (doc.content && doc.content.length > this.assessmentRules.maxContentLength) {
      issues.push('内容过长');
      score -= 0.1;
    }
    if (!doc.metadata || Object.keys(doc.metadata).length === 0) {
      issues.push('缺少元数据');
      score -= 0.2;
    }
    if (!doc.metadata || !doc.metadata.updatedAt) {
      issues.push('缺少更新时间');
      score -= 0.1;
    }
    if (doc.content && !doc.content.trim()) {
      issues.push('内容全为空白字符');
      score -= 0.5;
    }
    return { score: Math.max(0, score), issues };
  }

  _checkConsistency(doc) {
    const issues = [];
    let score = 1.0;
    if (!doc.id) { issues.push('缺少文档ID'); score -= 0.5; }
    if (doc.metadata && doc.metadata.createdAt && doc.metadata.updatedAt) {
      if (doc.metadata.updatedAt < doc.metadata.createdAt) {
        issues.push('更新时间早于创建时间');
        score -= 0.3;
      }
    }
    const terms = this.indexBuilder._tokenize(doc.content || '');
    if (terms.length === 0 && doc.content && doc.content.trim()) {
      issues.push('无法分词');
      score -= 0.2;
    }
    return { score: Math.max(0, score), issues };
  }

  _checkQuality(doc) {
    const issues = [];
    let score = 1.0;
    const content = doc.content || '';
    const meaningfulRatio = content.replace(/[\s\n\r\t]/g, '').length / (content.length || 1);
    if (meaningfulRatio < 0.5) { issues.push('有效内容占比过低'); score -= 0.3; }
    const specialCharRatio = (content.match(/[^\u4e00-\u9fa5a-zA-Z0-9\s]/g) || []).length / (content.length || 1);
    if (specialCharRatio > 0.3) { issues.push('特殊字符过多'); score -= 0.2; }
    const avgSentenceLen = content.length / ((content.match(/[。！？.!?]/g) || []).length + 1);
    if (avgSentenceLen > 500) { issues.push('句子过长'); score -= 0.2; }
    if (avgSentenceLen < 5 && content.length > 50) { issues.push('句子过短'); score -= 0.1; }
    return { score: Math.max(0, score), issues };
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块六：知识库分类组织
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeCategoryManager {
  constructor(indexBuilder, logger, cache) {
    this.indexBuilder = indexBuilder;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.categories = new Map();
    this.tags = new Map();
    this.hierarchy = { root: { id: 'root', name: '根目录', children: [] } };
  }

  autoClassify(document) {
    try {
      const doc = Validator.validateObject(document, 'document', { required: true });
      const categories = this._inferCategories(doc);
      const tags = this._extractTags(doc);
      const result = { id: doc.id, categories, tags, hierarchy: this._buildHierarchy(categories) };
      this.logger.info('Category', `自动分类: ${doc.id} -> ${categories.join(', ')}`);
      return this._response(0, '自动分类完成', result);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'AUTO_CLASSIFY_ERROR');
    }
  }

  addCategory(name, parentId = 'root') {
    try {
      const catName = Validator.validateString(name, 'name', { required: true });
      const catId = `cat_${crypto.randomBytes(6).toString('hex')}`;
      const category = { id: catId, name: catName, parentId, createdAt: Date.now(), docCount: 0 };
      this.categories.set(catId, category);
      if (this.hierarchy[parentId]) {
        this.hierarchy[parentId].children.push({ id: catId, name: catName });
        this.hierarchy[catId] = { id: catId, name: catName, children: [] };
      }
      this.logger.info('Category', `添加分类: ${catName}`);
      return this._response(0, '分类添加成功', { category });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'CATEGORY_ADD_ERROR');
    }
  }

  deleteCategory(id) {
    try {
      const catId = Validator.validateString(id, 'id', { required: true });
      if (!this.categories.has(catId)) throw new KnowledgeError(`分类不存在: ${catId}`, 'CAT_NOT_FOUND');
      this.categories.delete(catId);
      delete this.hierarchy[catId];
      this.logger.info('Category', `删除分类: ${catId}`);
      return this._response(0, '分类删除成功', { id: catId });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'CATEGORY_DELETE_ERROR');
    }
  }

  addTag(tagName, docIds = []) {
    try {
      const name = Validator.validateString(tagName, 'tagName', { required: true });
      if (!this.tags.has(name)) {
        this.tags.set(name, { name, docIds: new Set(), createdAt: Date.now() });
      }
      const tag = this.tags.get(name);
      docIds.forEach(id => tag.docIds.add(id));
      this.logger.info('Category', `添加标签: ${name}`);
      return this._response(0, '标签添加成功', { name, docCount: tag.docIds.size });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'TAG_ADD_ERROR');
    }
  }

  removeTag(tagName, docId = null) {
    try {
      const name = Validator.validateString(tagName, 'tagName', { required: true });
      if (!this.tags.has(name)) throw new KnowledgeError(`标签不存在: ${name}`, 'TAG_NOT_FOUND');
      if (docId) {
        this.tags.get(name).docIds.delete(docId);
      } else {
        this.tags.delete(name);
      }
      this.logger.info('Category', `移除标签: ${name}`);
      return this._response(0, '标签移除成功', { name });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'TAG_REMOVE_ERROR');
    }
  }

  getHierarchy() {
    return this._response(0, '层级结构获取成功', {
      root: this.hierarchy.root,
      totalCategories: this.categories.size,
      totalTags: this.tags.size
    });
  }

  _inferCategories(doc) {
    const categories = [];
    const content = (doc.content || '').toLowerCase();
    const rules = [
      { pattern: /技术|代码|编程|算法|开发/, category: '技术文档' },
      { pattern: /产品|需求|功能|设计|原型/, category: '产品文档' },
      { pattern: /运营|营销|推广|活动|用户/, category: '运营文档' },
      { pattern: /财务|预算|报表|成本|利润/, category: '财务文档' },
      { pattern: /人事|招聘|培训|绩效|组织/, category: '人事文档' },
      { pattern: /合同|法律|条款|协议|合规/, category: '法律文档' },
      { pattern: /研究|报告|分析|数据|统计/, category: '研究报告' },
      { pattern: /教程|指南|手册|入门|教程/, category: '教程文档' }
    ];
    for (const rule of rules) {
      if (rule.pattern.test(content)) categories.push(rule.category);
    }
    if (categories.length === 0) categories.push('未分类');
    return categories;
  }

  _extractTags(doc) {
    const tags = new Set();
    const content = doc.content || '';
    const keywords = this.indexBuilder._tokenize(content);
    const freq = new Map();
    for (const kw of keywords) {
      freq.set(kw, (freq.get(kw) || 0) + 1);
    }
    Array.from(freq.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 5).forEach(([tag]) => tags.add(tag));
    return Array.from(tags);
  }

  _buildHierarchy(categories) {
    return { level1: categories[0] || '默认', level2: categories.slice(1) };
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块七：知识库同步备份
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeSyncBackup {
  constructor(config = {}, indexBuilder, logger, cache) {
    this.config = config;
    this.indexBuilder = indexBuilder;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.syncRecords = [];
    this.backupList = [];
    this.lastSyncTime = null;
  }

  incrementalSync(targetPath) {
    try {
      const tp = Validator.validateString(targetPath, 'targetPath', { required: true });
      if (!fs.existsSync(tp)) throw new KnowledgeError(`目标路径不存在: ${tp}`, 'TARGET_NOT_FOUND');
      const changes = this._detectChanges();
      const { added, updated, deleted } = changes;
      const syncData = {
        source: this.config.indexPath,
        target: tp,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        changes: { added: added.length, updated: updated.length, deleted: deleted.length },
        data: { added, updated, deleted }
      };
      this._writeBackup(tp, syncData);
      this.syncRecords.push(syncData);
      this.lastSyncTime = Date.now();
      this.logger.info('Sync', `增量同步完成: +${added.length} ~${updated.length} -${deleted.length}`);
      return this._response(0, '增量同步完成', syncData);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'INCREMENTAL_SYNC_ERROR');
    }
  }

  fullBackup() {
    try {
      const backupPath = this.config.backupPath || './backup';
      fs.mkdirSync(backupPath, { recursive: true });
      const timestamp = Date.now();
      const backupFile = path.join(backupPath, `backup_${timestamp}.json`);
      const data = {
        version: '1.0',
        timestamp,
        documents: Array.from(this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.entries()),
        indexMeta: {
          docCount: this.indexBuilder.docCount,
          avgDocLength: this.indexBuilder.avgDocLength
        }
      };
      fs.writeFileSync(backupFile, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
      this.backupList.push({ file: backupFile, timestamp, size: Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(data)) });
      this.logger.info('Backup', `全量备份完成: ${backupFile}`);
      return this._response(0, '全量备份完成', { file: backupFile, size: data.documents.length });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'FULL_BACKUP_ERROR');
    }
  }

  restoreVersion(backupFile) {
    try {
      const file = Validator.validateString(backupFile, 'backupFile', { required: true });
      if (!fs.existsSync(file)) throw new KnowledgeError(`备份文件不存在: ${file}`, 'BACKUP_NOT_FOUND');
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8');
      const data = JSON.parse(raw);
      this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.clear();
      this.indexBuilder.invertedIndex.clear();
      this.indexBuilder.docLengths.clear();
      for (const [id, doc] of data.documents) {
        this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.set(id, doc);
      }
      this.indexBuilder.docCount = data.indexMeta.docCount;
      this.indexBuilder.avgDocLength = data.indexMeta.avgDocLength;
      this.cache.clear();
      this.logger.info('Backup', `版本恢复完成: ${file}`);
      return this._response(0, '版本恢复成功', { restoredDocs: data.documents.length });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'RESTORE_ERROR');
    }
  }

  listBackups() {
    try {
      const backupPath = this.config.backupPath || './backup';
      if (!fs.existsSync(backupPath)) return this._response(0, '备份列表', { backups: [] });
      const files = fs.readdirSync(backupPath)
        .filter(f => f.startsWith('backup_') && f.endsWith('.json'))
        .map(f => {
          const stat = fs.statSync(path.join(backupPath, f));
          return { file: f, size: stat.size, createdAt: stat.mtimeMs };
        })
        .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
      return this._response(0, '备份列表获取成功', { backups: files });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'LIST_BACKUPS_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _detectChanges() {
    return { added: [], updated: [], deleted: [] };
  }

  _writeBackup(targetPath, data) {
    try {
      fs.mkdirSync(targetPath, { recursive: true });
      const filePath = path.join(targetPath, `sync_${Date.now()}.json`);
      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error('Sync', `写入备份失败: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块八：知识库分析统计
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeAnalyticsEngine {
  constructor(indexBuilder, logger, cache) {
    this.indexBuilder = indexBuilder;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.usageStats = new Map();
    this.searchLogs = [];
    this.popularityScores = new Map();
  }

  recordSearch(query, results) {
    try {
      const log = {
        query,
        resultCount: results.length,
        topResults: results.slice(0, 5).map(r => r.id),
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        duration: results._duration || 0
      };
      this.searchLogs.push(log);
      if (this.searchLogs.length > 10000) this.searchLogs.shift();
      for (const r of results) {
        if (r.id) {
          this.popularityScores.set(r.id, (this.popularityScores.get(r.id) || 0) + 1);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error('Analytics', `记录搜索失败: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  getUsageStats(timeRange = {}) {
    try {
      const cacheKey = `stats:${JSON.stringify(timeRange)}`;
      const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
      if (cached) return cached;
      const stats = {
        totalDocuments: this.indexBuilder.docCount,
        totalSearches: this.searchLogs.length,
        popularDocs: this._getPopularDocs(10),
        searchTypes: this._analyzeSearchTypes(),
        avgResultsPerSearch: this.searchLogs.length > 0
          ? parseFloat((this.searchLogs.reduce((s, l) => s + l.resultCount, 0) / this.searchLogs.length).toFixed(2))
          : 0,
        topQueries: this._getTopQueries(10),
        timeRange,
        generatedAt: Date.now()
      };
      const response = this._response(0, '使用统计获取成功', stats);
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, response);
      return response;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'USAGE_STATS_ERROR');
    }
  }

  getPopularContent(limit = 20) {
    try {
      const docs = this._getPopularDocs(limit);
      return this._response(0, '热门内容获取成功', { items: docs });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'POPULAR_CONTENT_ERROR');
    }
  }

  getEffectAnalysis() {
    try {
      const analysis = {
        totalSearches: this.searchLogs.length,
        avgSearchResults: this.searchLogs.length > 0
          ? this.searchLogs.reduce((s, l) => s + l.resultCount, 0) / this.searchLogs.length
          : 0,
        zeroResultSearches: this.searchLogs.filter(l => l.resultCount === 0).length,
        zeroResultRate: this.searchLogs.length > 0
          ? parseFloat((this.searchLogs.filter(l => l.resultCount === 0).length / this.searchLogs.length).toFixed(4))
          : 0,
        coverageRate: this.indexBuilder.docCount > 0
          ? parseFloat(((this.popularityScores.size / this.indexBuilder.docCount) * 100).toFixed(2))
          : 0,
        popularQueries: this._getTopQueries(5),
        recommendations: this._generateRecommendations()
      };
      return this._response(0, '效果分析获取成功', analysis);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'EFFECT_ANALYSIS_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _getPopularDocs(limit) {
    return Array.from(this.popularityScores.entries())
      .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
      .slice(0, limit)
      .map(([id, count]) => {
        const doc = this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.get(id);
        return doc ? { id, title: doc.metadata?.title || doc.id, accessCount: count } : { id, accessCount: count };
      });
  }

  _analyzeSearchTypes() {
    return { keyword: 0, semantic: 0, hybrid: 0 };
  }

  _getTopQueries(limit) {
    const queryCounts = new Map();
    for (const log of this.searchLogs) {
      queryCounts.set(log.query, (queryCounts.get(log.query) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return Array.from(queryCounts.entries())
      .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
      .slice(0, limit)
      .map(([query, count]) => ({ query, count }));
  }

  _generateRecommendations() {
    const recommendations = [];
    const zeroResultQueries = this.searchLogs.filter(l => l.resultCount === 0).map(l => l.query);
    if (zeroResultQueries.length > 0) {
      recommendations.push({ type: 'coverage', message: `有${zeroResultQueries.length}个查询无结果，建议补充相关文档` });
    }
    if (this.indexBuilder.docCount < 10) {
      recommendations.push({ type: 'quantity', message: '知识库文档数量较少，建议增加内容' });
    }
    return recommendations;
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 模块九：知识库安全管理
// ============================================================================
class KnowledgeSecurityManager {
  constructor(config = {}, logger, cache) {
    this.config = config;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.permissions = new Map();
    this.accessLogs = [];
    this.encryptionKey = config.encryptKey || null;
  }

  setPermission(userId, resource, actions) {
    try {
      const uid = Validator.validateString(userId, 'userId', { required: true });
      const res = Validator.validateString(resource, 'resource', { required: true });
      const acts = Validator.validateArray(actions, 'actions', { required: true });
      if (!this.permissions.has(userId)) this.permissions.set(userId, new Map());
      const userPerms = this.permissions.get(userId);
      userPerms.set(res, new Set(acts));
      this.logger.info('Security', `设置权限: ${userId} -> ${res}: ${acts.join(',')}`);
      return this._response(0, '权限设置成功', { userId: uid, resource: res, actions: acts });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'PERMISSION_SET_ERROR');
    }
  }

  checkPermission(userId, resource, action) {
    try {
      const uid = Validator.validateString(userId, 'userId', { required: true });
      const res = Validator.validateString(resource, 'resource', { required: true });
      const act = Validator.validateString(action, 'action', { required: true });
      const userPerms = this.permissions.get(uid);
      if (!userPerms) return false;
      const resourcePerms = userPerms.get(res);
      if (!resourcePerms) return false;
      return resourcePerms.has(act) || resourcePerms.has('*');
    } catch (err) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  logAccess(userId, resource, action, granted) {
    try {
      const log = { userId, resource, action, granted, timestamp: Date.now(), ip: null };
      this.accessLogs.push(log);
      if (this.accessLogs.length > 50000) this.accessLogs.shift();
    } catch (err) {
      this.logger.error('Security', `访问日志记录失败: ${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  getAccessLogs(filter = {}) {
    try {
      const logs = this.accessLogs.filter(log => {
        if (filter.userId && log.userId !== filter.userId) return false;
        if (filter.resource && log.resource !== filter.resource) return false;
        if (filter.action && log.action !== filter.action) return false;
        if (filter.granted !== undefined && log.granted !== filter.granted) return false;
        if (filter.startTime && log.timestamp < filter.startTime) return false;
        if (filter.endTime && log.timestamp > filter.endTime) return false;
        return true;
      });
      return this._response(0, '访问日志获取成功', { total: logs.length, items: logs.slice(-1000) });
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'ACCESS_LOGS_ERROR');
    }
  }

  encryptData(data) {
    try {
      if (!this.encryptionKey) throw new KnowledgeError('未配置加密密钥', 'NO_ENCRYPT_KEY');
      const key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(this.encryptionKey).digest();
      const iv = crypto.randomBytes(16);
      const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-cbc', key, iv);
      const encrypted = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(JSON.stringify(data), 'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
      return { encrypted: encrypted.toString('base64'), iv: iv.toString('base64') };
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'ENCRYPT_ERROR');
    }
  }

  decryptData(encrypted, iv) {
    try {
      if (!this.encryptionKey) throw new KnowledgeError('未配置加密密钥', 'NO_ENCRYPT_KEY');
      const key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(this.encryptionKey).digest();
      const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-cbc', key, Buffer.from(iv, 'base64'));
      const decrypted = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(Buffer.from(encrypted, 'base64')), decipher.final()]);
      return JSON.parse(decrypted.toString('utf-8'));
    } catch (err) {
      throw new KnowledgeError(err.message, 'DECRYPT_ERROR');
    }
  }

  _response(code, message, data = {}) {
    return { code, message, data, timestamp: Date.now(), requestId: crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex') };
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 主入口：超级知识库
// ============================================================================
class SuperKnowledgeBase extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(userConfig = {}) {
    super();
    this.config = {
      cacheSize: 1000,
      cacheTTL: 3600,
      indexPath: './index',
      backupPath: './backup',
      encryptKey: null,
      maxFileSize: 10485760,
      allowedTypes: ALLOWED_FILE_TYPES,
      enableCache: true,
      enableLog: true,
      ...userConfig
    };
    this.cache = new CacheManager({ maxSize: this.config.cacheSize, ttl: this.config.cacheTTL });
    this.logger = new Logger(this.config.enableLog);
    this.uploader = new KnowledgeUploadManager(this.config, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.indexBuilder = new KnowledgeIndexBuilder(this.config, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.searchEngine = new KnowledgeSearchEngine(this.indexBuilder, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.contentManager = new KnowledgeContentManager(this.indexBuilder, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.qualityAssessor = new KnowledgeQualityAssessor(this.indexBuilder, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.categoryManager = new KnowledgeCategoryManager(this.indexBuilder, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.syncBackup = new KnowledgeSyncBackup(this.config, this.indexBuilder, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.analytics = new KnowledgeAnalyticsEngine(this.indexBuilder, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.security = new KnowledgeSecurityManager(this.config, this.logger, this.cache);
    this.logger.info('SuperKB', `超级知识库初始化完成 v1.0.0`);
  }

  static get VERSION() { return '1.0.0'; }

  // ========== 上传管理API ==========
  async uploadFiles(files) { return this.uploader.batchUpload(files); }

  // ========== 索引构建API ==========
  buildIndex(documents) { return this.indexBuilder.buildIndex(documents); }

  // ========== 搜索查询API ==========
  searchByKeyword(query, options) { return this.searchEngine.keywordSearch(query, options); }
  searchBySemantic(query, options) { return this.searchEngine.semanticSearch(query, options); }
  search(query, options) { return this.searchEngine.hybridSearch(query, options); }

  // ========== 内容管理API ==========
  addDocument(doc) { return this.contentManager.addDocument(doc); }
  getDocument(id) { return this.contentManager.getDocument(id); }
  updateDocument(id, updates) { return this.contentManager.updateDocument(id, updates); }
  deleteDocument(id) { return this.contentManager.deleteDocument(id); }
  getVersionHistory(id) { return this.contentManager.getVersionHistory(id); }
  rollbackVersion(id, version) { return this.contentManager.rollbackVersion(id, version); }

  // ========== 质量评估API ==========
  assessDocumentQuality(id) { return this.qualityAssessor.assessQuality(id); }
  batchAssessQuality(ids) { return this.qualityAssessor.batchAssessQuality(ids); }

  // ========== 分类组织API ==========
  autoClassify(doc) { return this.categoryManager.autoClassify(doc); }
  addCategory(name, parentId) { return this.categoryManager.addCategory(name, parentId); }
  deleteCategory(id) { return this.categoryManager.deleteCategory(id); }
  addTag(tag, docIds) { return this.categoryManager.addTag(tag, docIds); }
  removeTag(tag, docId) { return this.categoryManager.removeTag(tag, docId); }
  getCategoryHierarchy() { return this.categoryManager.getHierarchy(); }

  // ========== 同步备份API ==========
  syncIncremental(targetPath) { return this.syncBackup.incrementalSync(targetPath); }
  createFullBackup() { return this.syncBackup.fullBackup(); }
  restoreFromBackup(file) { return this.syncBackup.restoreVersion(file); }
  listBackups() { return this.syncBackup.listBackups(); }

  // ========== 分析统计API ==========
  getUsageStats(timeRange) { return this.analytics.getUsageStats(timeRange); }
  getPopularContent(limit) { return this.analytics.getPopularContent(limit); }
  getEffectAnalysis() { return this.analytics.getEffectAnalysis(); }

  // ========== 安全管理API ==========
  setPermission(userId, resource, actions) { return this.security.setPermission(userId, resource, actions); }
  checkPermission(userId, resource, action) { return this.security.checkPermission(userId, resource, action); }
  getAccessLogs(filter) { return this.security.getAccessLogs(filter); }
  logAccess(userId, resource, action, granted) { return this.security.logAccess(userId, resource, action, granted); }
  encryptData(data) { return this.security.encryptData(data); }
  decryptData(encrypted, iv) { return this.security.decryptData(encrypted, iv); }

  // ========== 缓存管理API ==========
  getCacheStats() { return this.cache.getStats(); }
  clearCache() { this.cache.clear(); this.logger.info('SuperKB', '缓存已清空'); }

  // ========== 系统API ==========
  getSystemInfo() {
    return {
      version: SuperKnowledgeBase.VERSION,
      config: { ...this.config, encryptKey: this.config.encryptKey ? '***' : null },
      cache: this.cache.getStats(),
      indexes: {
        documentCount: this.indexBuilder.docCount,
        indexSize: this.indexBuilder.forwardIndex.size
      },
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }

  destroy() {
    this.clearCache();
    this.logger.info('SuperKB', '超级知识库已销毁');
    this.removeAllListeners();
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 导出
// ============================================================================
module.exports = { SuperKnowledgeBase, KnowledgeUploadManager, KnowledgeIndexBuilder, KnowledgeSearchEngine, KnowledgeContentManager, KnowledgeQualityAssessor, KnowledgeCategoryManager, KnowledgeSyncBackup, KnowledgeAnalyticsEngine, KnowledgeSecurityManager, CacheManager, Validator, ValidationError, KnowledgeError };

/**
 * ============================================================================
 *  超级提示词合并引擎 (Super Prompt Merge Engine)
 * ============================================================================
 *
 *  工具介绍：
 *  本工具是一个超级提示词合并引擎，整合了角色设定、任务执行、输出格式三大
 *  核心提示词模块，支持动态参数填充、提示词组合优化、效果评估及 A/B 测试。
 *  适用于 AI 应用开发、智能助手构建、自动化工作流等场景。
 *
 *  核心功能：
 *  1. 角色设定提示词 —— AI 架构师、代码专家、内容创作者三大角色
 *  2. 任务执行提示词 —— 代码生成、问题解决、内容创作三大任务类型
 *  3. 输出格式提示词 —— 结构化输出、代码格式、文档格式三大输出规范
 *  4. 提示词组合与优化 —— 智能合并、去重、权重调节
 *  5. 提示词效果评估 —— 质量评分、覆盖率分析、冗余检测
 *  6. A/B 测试支持 —— 多版本对比、统计显著性检验
 *
 *  输入参数配置表格：
 *  ┌──────────────┬──────────┬────────────┬───────────────────────────────┐
 *  │ 参数名        │ 类型     │ 是否必填   │ 说明                          │
 *  ├──────────────┼──────────┼────────────┼───────────────────────────────┤
 *  │ role         │ string   │ 是        │ 角色标识: architect/coder/     │
 *  │              │          │           │ creator/all                   │
 *  │ task         │ string   │ 是        │ 任务类型: code/problem/       │
 *  │              │          │           │ content/all                   │
 *  │ outputFormat │ string   │ 是        │ 输出格式: structured/code/     │
 *  │              │          │           │ document/all                  │
 *  │ params       │ object   │ 否        │ 动态参数键值对                │
 *  │ options      │ object   │ 否        │ 配置选项(温度/最大长度等)     │
 *  │ abTest       │ boolean  │ 否        │ 是否启用 A/B 测试             │
 *  │ version      │ string   │ 否        │ 指定版本号                    │
 *  └──────────────┴──────────┴────────────┴───────────────────────────────┘
 *
 *  输出参数配置表格：
 *  ┌──────────────┬──────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 *  │ 字段名        │ 类型     │ 说明                                        │
 *  ├──────────────┼──────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 *  │ finalPrompt  │ string   │ 最终合并后的完整提示词                      │
 *  │ components   │ array    │ 各模块提示词明细                            │
 *  │ metadata     │ object   │ 元数据(版本/时间戳/字符统计等)              │
 *  │ evaluation   │ object   │ 效果评估结果                                │
 *  │ abResult     │ object   │ A/B 测试对比结果(仅启用时返回)              │
 *  └──────────────┴──────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 *
 *  使用示例：
 *    const engine = require('./super_prompt.js');
 *    const result = engine.generate({
 *      role: 'architect',
 *      task: 'code',
 *      outputFormat: 'structured',
 *      params: { projectName: '智能客服系统', techStack: 'Node.js' }
 *    });
 *    console.log(result.finalPrompt);
 * ============================================================================
 */

 * @param {<type>} <name> - <参数说明>
 * @returns {<type>} <返回值说明>
 * @throws {<ErrorType>} <异常说明>
 * @example
 *   const result = functionName(param1, param2);
 */
function functionName(param1, param2) {
  // 实现逻辑
}

// 导出
module.exports = { functionName };
\`\`\`

输出规范：
1. 每个代码文件以文件头注释开始
2. 公共 API 必须有 JSDoc 注释
3. 关键逻辑处添加行内注释说明意图
4. 保持统一的缩进和空格风格
5. 结尾处说明导出方式和使用示例`,
    validation: [
      '检查代码语法合法性',
      '验证 JSDoc 注释完整性',
      '确认导出方式正确性',
      '检查命名规范一致性'
    ]
  },

  document: {
    id: 'output_document',
    name: '文档输出格式',
    description: '以 Markdown 文档形式输出，结构清晰的格式规范',
    template: `请以标准 Markdown 格式输出文档，遵循以下结构：
