// ============================================================================
// 第四部分：提示词组合与优化引擎
// ============================================================================

class PromptComposer {
  constructor(config = {}) {
    this.config = {
      separator: config.separator || '\n\n---\n\n',
      includeMetadata: config.includeMetadata !== false,
      optimizeEnabled: config.optimizeEnabled !== false,
      maxTokens: config.maxTokens || 4000,
      ...config
    };
    this.history = [];
  }

  /**
   * 组合多个提示词模块
   * @param {Object} options - 组合选项
   * @param {string[]} options.modules - 模块ID列表
   * @param {Object} options.params - 动态参数
   * @returns {Object} 组合结果
   */
  compose(options) {
    const { modules = [], params = {} } = options;
    const components = [];
    let mergedPrompt = '';

    for (const moduleId of modules) {
      const moduleData = this._resolveModule(moduleId);
      if (!moduleData) {
        console.warn(`[PromptComposer] 未找到模块: ${moduleId}`);
        continue;
      }

      const filledPrompt = this._fillParams(moduleData.prompt, params);
      const optimizedPrompt = this.config.optimizeEnabled
        ? this._optimize(filledPrompt)
        : filledPrompt;

      components.push({
        id: moduleData.id,
        name: moduleData.name,
        type: moduleData.type,
        originalLength: moduleData.prompt.length,
        optimizedLength: optimizedPrompt.length,
        weight: moduleData.weight || 1.0
      });

      if (mergedPrompt) {
        mergedPrompt += this.config.separator;
      }
      mergedPrompt += optimizedPrompt;
    }

    const result = {
      finalPrompt: mergedPrompt,
      components,
      metadata: {
        version: '1.0.0',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        totalCharacters: mergedPrompt.length,
        moduleCount: components.length,
        separator: this.config.separator
      }
    };

    this.history.push(result);
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * 解析模块 ID，获取对应提示词
   * @private
   */
  _resolveModule(moduleId) {
    const allModules = {
      ...Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(ROLE_PROMPTS).map(([key, val]) => [
          val.id,
          { ...val, type: 'role', prompt: val.system }
        ])
      ),
      ...Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(TASK_PROMPTS).map(([key, val]) => [
          val.id,
          { ...val, type: 'task', prompt: val.instruction }
        ])
      ),
      ...Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(OUTPUT_PROMPTS).map(([key, val]) => [
          val.id,
          { ...val, type: 'output', prompt: val.template }
        ])
      )
    };

    if (moduleId === 'all-roles') {
      const merged = Object.values(ROLE_PROMPTS)
        .map(r => r.system)
        .join(this.config.separator);
      return {
        id: 'all-roles',
        name: '全部角色',
        type: 'role',
        prompt: merged,
        weight: 1.0
      };
    }

    if (moduleId === 'all-tasks') {
      const merged = Object.values(TASK_PROMPTS)
        .map(t => t.instruction)
        .join(this.config.separator);
      return {
        id: 'all-tasks',
        name: '全部任务',
        type: 'task',
        prompt: merged,
        weight: 1.0
      };
    }

    if (moduleId === 'all-outputs') {
      const merged = Object.values(OUTPUT_PROMPTS)
        .map(o => o.template)
        .join(this.config.separator);
      return {
        id: 'all-outputs',
        name: '全部输出格式',
        type: 'output',
        prompt: merged,
        weight: 1.0
      };
    }

    if (moduleId === 'all') {
      const merged = [
        Object.values(ROLE_PROMPTS).map(r => r.system).join('\n'),
        Object.values(TASK_PROMPTS).map(t => t.instruction).join('\n'),
        Object.values(OUTPUT_PROMPTS).map(o => o.template).join('\n')
      ].join(this.config.separator);
      return {
        id: 'all',
        name: '全部模块',
        type: 'combined',
        prompt: merged,
        weight: 1.0
      };
    }

    return allModules[moduleId] || null;
  }

  /**
   * 填充动态参数到提示词模板
   * @private
   */
  _fillParams(template, params) {
    let result = template;
    const paramRegex = /\{(\w+)\}/g;
    let match;
    const usedParams = new Set();

    while ((match = paramRegex.exec(template)) !== null) {
      const key = match[1];
      if (params[key] !== undefined) {
        result = result.replace(`{${key}}`, String(params[key]));
        usedParams.add(key);
      } else {
        result = result.replace(`{${key}}`, `[未提供参数: ${key}]`);
      }
    }

    result = result.replace(paramRegex, (_, key) => `[未提供参数: ${key}]`);

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * 优化提示词（去冗余、标准化格式）
   * @private
   */
  _optimize(prompt) {
    let optimized = prompt;

    optimized = optimized.replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ');
    optimized = optimized.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
    optimized = optimized.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
    optimized = optimized.replace(/\s+\n/g, '\n');
    optimized = optimized.trim();

    return optimized;
  }

  /**
   * 设置配置选项
   * @param {Object} newConfig - 新配置
   */
  setConfig(newConfig) {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...newConfig };
    return this;
  }

  /**
   * 获取历史记录
   * @returns {Array} 历史组合结果
   */
  getHistory() {
    return this.history;
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 第五部分：提示词效果评估器
// ============================================================================

class PromptEvaluator {
  constructor() {
    this.evaluationCriteria = {
      completeness: {
        name: '完整性',
        weight: 0.25,
        description: '检查提示词是否包含所有必要元素'
      },
      clarity: {
        name: '清晰度',
        weight: 0.25,
        description: '评估提示词表达是否清晰无歧义'
      },
      specificity: {
        name: '具体性',
        weight: 0.20,
        description: '评估指令是否具体可执行'
      },
      structure: {
        name: '结构性',
        weight: 0.15,
        description: '评估提示词的组织结构'
      },
      constraints: {
        name: '约束性',
        weight: 0.15,
        description: '检查是否包含必要的约束条件'
      }
    };
  }

  /**
   * 全面评估提示词
   * @param {string} prompt - 待评估的提示词
   * @returns {Object} 评估结果
   */
  evaluate(prompt) {
    const scores = {
      completeness: this._evaluateCompleteness(prompt),
      clarity: this._evaluateClarity(prompt),
      specificity: this._evaluateSpecificity(prompt),
      structure: this._evaluateStructure(prompt),
      constraints: this._evaluateConstraints(prompt)
    };

    const weightedScore = Object.entries(scores).reduce((total, [key, score]) => {
      return total + score * (this.evaluationCriteria[key].weight || 0);
    }, 0);

    const issues = this._identifyIssues(prompt, scores);
    const suggestions = this._generateSuggestions(issues, scores);

    return {
      overallScore: Math.round(weightedScore * 100) / 100,
      scores,
      weightedBreakdown: Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(scores).map(([key, score]) => [
          key,
          {
            raw: score,
            weight: this.evaluationCriteria[key].weight,
            weighted: Math.round(score * this.evaluationCriteria[key].weight * 100) / 100
          }
        ])
      ),
      issues,
      suggestions,
      statistics: {
        totalCharacters: prompt.length,
        lineCount: prompt.split('\n').length,
        wordCount: prompt.trim().split(/\s+/).length,
        paragraphCount: prompt.split(/\n\s*\n/).filter(p => p.trim()).length,
        hasCodeBlocks: /```[\s\S]*?```/.test(prompt),
        hasLists: /[-*+]\s/m.test(prompt),
        hasHeaders: /^#{1,6}\s/m.test(prompt),
        hasPlaceholders: /\{\w+\}/.test(prompt)
      },
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  /**
   * 评估完整性
   * @private
   */
  _evaluateCompleteness(prompt) {
    let score = 0;
    const indicators = [
      { pattern: /角色|role|身份|persona/i, weight: 0.15 },
      { pattern: /任务|task|指令|instruction/i, weight: 0.15 },
      { pattern: /格式|format|输出|output/i, weight: 0.15 },
      { pattern: /约束|限制|constraint|requirement/i, weight: 0.15 },
      { pattern: /示例|example|例子/i, weight: 0.1 },
      { pattern: /步骤|step|过程/i, weight: 0.1 },
      { pattern: /注意|note|warning|注意事项/i, weight: 0.1 },
      { pattern: /边界|edge|异常|error/i, weight: 0.05 }
    ];

    for (const { pattern, weight } of indicators) {
      if (pattern.test(prompt)) {
        score += weight;
      }
    }

    return Math.min(score, 1.0);
  }

  /**
   * 评估清晰度
   * @private
   */
  _evaluateClarity(prompt) {
    let score = 1.0;

    const ambiguousWords = ['一些', '可能', '大概', '之类', '等等', '差不多', '好像'];
    for (const word of ambiguousWords) {
      const occurrences = (prompt.match(new RegExp(word, 'gi')) || []).length;
      score -= occurrences * 0.05;
    }

    const avgLineLength = prompt.length / Math.max(prompt.split('\n').length, 1);
    if (avgLineLength > 100) {
      score -= 0.15;
    } else if (avgLineLength > 80) {
      score -= 0.05;
    }

    const hasMarkdown = /[#*>\-`]/.test(prompt);
    if (!hasMarkdown) {
      score -= 0.2;
    }

    return Math.max(Math.min(score, 1.0), 0);
  }

  /**
   * 评估具体性
   * @private
   */
  _evaluateSpecificity(prompt) {
    let score = 0.5;

    const hasNumbers = /\d+/.test(prompt);
    if (hasNumbers) score += 0.1;

    const hasTechnicalTerms = /function|class|API|JSON|HTML|CSS|Node|React|TypeScript/i.test(prompt);
    if (hasTechnicalTerms) score += 0.1;

    const hasPlaceholder = /\{\w+\}/.test(prompt);
    if (hasPlaceholder) score += 0.1;

    const hasFormatSpec = /格式|format|```/.test(prompt);
    if (hasFormatSpec) score += 0.1;

    const hasRange = /\d+\s*[-~至]\s*\d+/.test(prompt);
    if (hasRange) score += 0.1;

    return Math.min(score, 1.0);
  }

  /**
   * 评估结构性
   * @private
   */
  _evaluateStructure(prompt) {
    let score = 0;

    const hasHeaders = /^#{1,6}\s/m.test(prompt);
    if (hasHeaders) score += 0.25;

    const hasLists = /^[-*+]\s/m.test(prompt);
    if (hasLists) score += 0.2;

    const hasCodeBlocks = /```[\s\S]*?```/.test(prompt);
    if (hasCodeBlocks) score += 0.15;

    const hasTables = /\|.*\|.*\|/m.test(prompt);
    if (hasTables) score += 0.15;

    const hasBlockquotes = /^>\s/m.test(prompt);
    if (hasBlockquotes) score += 0.1;

    const paragraphCount = prompt.split(/\n\s*\n/).filter(p => p.trim()).length;
    if (paragraphCount >= 3) score += 0.15;

    return Math.min(score, 1.0);
  }

  /**
   * 评估约束性
   * @private
   */
  _evaluateConstraints(prompt) {
    let score = 0;

    const hasDoNot = /不要|不得|禁止|must not|don't|never/i.test(prompt);
    if (hasDoNot) score += 0.25;

    const hasMust = /必须|务必|一定要|must|should/i.test(prompt);
    if (hasMust) score += 0.25;

    const hasFormatConstraint = /格式|format|语法|syntax/i.test(prompt);
    if (hasFormatConstraint) score += 0.2;

    const hasQualityStandard = /质量|标准|规范|quality|standard/i.test(prompt);
    if (hasQualityStandard) score += 0.15;

    const hasTimeConstraint = /时间|deadline|按时|time/i.test(prompt);
    if (hasTimeConstraint) score += 0.15;

    return Math.min(score, 1.0);
  }

  /**
   * 识别问题
   * @private
   */
  _identifyIssues(prompt, scores) {
    const issues = [];

    if (scores.completeness < 0.6) {
      issues.push({
        level: 'high',
        category: 'completeness',
        message: '提示词缺少关键组成部分（角色/任务/格式/约束）',
        suggestion: '补充角色设定、任务说明、输出格式和约束条件'
      });
    }

    if (scores.clarity < 0.6) {
      issues.push({
        level: 'high',
        category: 'clarity',
        message: '提示词表达存在歧义或不够清晰',
        suggestion: '使用更具体的术语，避免模糊表达，增加示例'
      });
    }

    if (scores.specificity < 0.5) {
      issues.push({
        level: 'medium',
        category: 'specificity',
        message: '提示词不够具体，可能导致执行结果偏差',
        suggestion: '添加具体的参数、数值约束和技术细节'
      });
    }

    if (scores.structure < 0.5) {
      issues.push({
        level: 'medium',
        category: 'structure',
        message: '提示词结构不够清晰',
        suggestion: '使用 Markdown 标题、列表、代码块等格式化元素'
      });
    }

    if (scores.constraints < 0.5) {
      issues.push({
        level: 'low',
        category: 'constraints',
        message: '提示词缺少约束条件',
        suggestion: '添加质量标准、禁止事项、格式规范等约束'
      });
    }

    if (prompt.length > 5000) {
      issues.push({
        level: 'medium',
        category: 'length',
        message: `提示词过长（${prompt.length}字符），可能影响执行效率`,
        suggestion: '精简提示词，去除冗余信息，保留核心指令'
      });
    }

    const placeholderCount = (prompt.match(/\{\w+\}/g) || []).length;
    if (placeholderCount > 5) {
      issues.push({
        level: 'low',
        category: 'placeholders',
        message: `提示词包含 ${placeholderCount} 个未填充的占位符`,
        suggestion: '在使用前填充所有必要参数'
      });
    }

    return issues;
  }

  /**
   * 生成优化建议
   * @private
   */
  _generateSuggestions(issues, scores) {
    const suggestions = [];

    if (scores.completeness < 0.7) {
      suggestions.push('建议使用 "角色 + 任务 + 格式 + 约束" 四段式结构');
    }

    if (scores.clarity < 0.7) {
      suggestions.push('建议为关键术语提供定义或上下文说明');
      suggestions.push('建议每段聚焦单一主题，避免信息过载');
    }

    if (scores.structure < 0.6) {
      suggestions.push('建议使用 Markdown 格式：# 标题、- 列表、```代码块```');
    }

    if (scores.specificity < 0.6) {
      suggestions.push('建议提供输入输出的具体示例');
      suggestions.push('建议使用占位符 {param} 实现参数化');
    }

    if (scores.constraints < 0.5) {
      suggestions.push('建议添加 "必须/禁止/应该" 等明确约束词');
    }

    return suggestions;
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 第六部分：A/B 测试框架
// ============================================================================

class PromptABTest {
  constructor(config = {}) {
    this.config = {
      minSamples: config.minSamples || 10,
      confidenceLevel: config.confidenceLevel || 0.95,
      metricWeights: config.metricWeights || {
        quality: 0.4,
        speed: 0.3,
        cost: 0.3
      }
    };
    this.experiments = new Map();
  }

  /**
   * 创建新的 A/B 测试实验
   * @param {Object} config - 实验配置
   * @param {string} config.name - 实验名称
   * @param {string} config.description - 实验描述
   * @param {Object} config.variantA - 版本A配置
   * @param {Object} config.variantB - 版本B配置
   * @returns {Object} 实验信息
   */
  createExperiment(config) {
    const experiment = {
      id: `exp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`,
      name: config.name,
      description: config.description,
      variantA: {
        ...config.variantA,
        samples: [],
        metrics: []
      },
      variantB: {
        ...config.variantB,
        samples: [],
        metrics: []
      },
      status: 'active',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      completedAt: null,
      results: null
    };

    this.experiments.set(experiment.id, experiment);
    return {
      id: experiment.id,
      name: experiment.name,
      status: experiment.status,
      message: `实验已创建，请使用 ID: ${experiment.id} 提交样本数据`
    };
  }

  /**
   * 提交实验样本数据
   * @param {string} experimentId - 实验ID
   * @param {string} variant - 'A' 或 'B'
   * @param {Object} sample - 样本数据
   * @returns {Object} 提交结果
   */
  submitSample(experimentId, variant, sample) {
    const experiment = this.experiments.get(experimentId);
    if (!experiment) {
      throw new Error(`实验不存在: ${experimentId}`);
    }
    if (experiment.status !== 'active') {
      throw new Error(`实验状态不活跃: ${experiment.status}`);
    }

    const targetVariant = variant === 'A' ? experiment.variantA : experiment.variantB;
    targetVariant.samples.push({
      ...sample,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      experimentId,
      variant,
      totalSamples: targetVariant.samples.length,
      message: `样本已提交，当前 ${variant} 组共 ${targetVariant.samples.length} 个样本`
    };
  }

  /**
   * 添加指标定义
   * @param {string} experimentId - 实验ID
   * @param {Object} metricConfig - 指标配置
   */
  addMetric(experimentId, metricConfig) {
    const experiment = this.experiments.get(experimentId);
    if (!experiment) {
      throw new Error(`实验不存在: ${experimentId}`);
    }

    const variant = metricConfig.variant === 'A' ? experiment.variantA : experiment.variantB;
    variant.metrics.push({
      name: metricConfig.name,
      value: metricConfig.value,
      weight: metricConfig.weight || 1.0,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    });

    return { success: true, message: '指标已记录' };
  }

  /**
   * 分析实验结果
   * @param {string} experimentId - 实验ID
   * @returns {Object} 分析结果
   */
  analyze(experimentId) {
    const experiment = this.experiments.get(experimentId);
    if (!experiment) {
      throw new Error(`实验不存在: ${experimentId}`);
    }

    const variantAStats = this._calculateStats(experiment.variantA);
    const variantBStats = this._calculateStats(experiment.variantB);

    const comparison = this._compareVariants(variantAStats, variantBStats);
    const significance = this._testSignificance(variantAStats, variantBStats);

    return {
      experimentId,
      name: experiment.name,
      status: experiment.status,
      variantA: variantAStats,
      variantB: variantBStats,
      comparison,
      significance,
      recommendation: this._recommend(comparison, significance),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }

  /**
   * 完成实验并生成报告
   * @param {string} experimentId - 实验ID
   * @returns {Object} 完整报告
   */
  completeExperiment(experimentId) {
    const experiment = this.experiments.get(experimentId);
    if (!experiment) {
      throw new Error(`实验不存在: ${experimentId}`);
    }

    experiment.status = 'completed';
    experiment.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    experiment.results = this.analyze(experimentId);

    return experiment.results;
  }

  /**
   * 获取所有实验列表
   * @returns {Array} 实验列表
   */
  listExperiments() {
    return Array.from(this.experiments.values()).map(exp => ({
      id: exp.id,
      name: exp.name,
      status: exp.status,
      samplesA: exp.variantA.samples.length,
      samplesB: exp.variantB.samples.length,
      createdAt: exp.createdAt
    }));
  }

  /**
   * 计算统计数据
   * @private
   */
  _calculateStats(variant) {
    const samples = variant.samples;
    if (samples.length === 0) {
      return { sampleCount: 0, error: '无样本数据' };
    }

    const numericFields = new Set();
    for (const sample of samples) {
      Object.entries(sample).forEach(([key, value]) => {
        if (typeof value === 'number' && key !== 'timestamp' && key !== 'id') {
          numericFields.add(key);
        }
      });
    }

    const fieldStats = {};
    for (const field of numericFields) {
      const values = samples
        .map(s => s[field])
        .filter(v => typeof v === 'number');
      if (values.length === 0) continue;

      const mean = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / values.length;
      const variance = values.reduce((sum, val) => sum + Math.pow(val - mean, 2), 0) / values.length;
      const stdDev = Math.sqrt(variance);
      const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      const median = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];

      fieldStats[field] = {
        mean: Math.round(mean * 1000) / 1000,
        stdDev: Math.round(stdDev * 1000) / 1000,
        min: sorted[0],
        max: sorted[sorted.length - 1],
        median: Math.round(median * 1000) / 1000,
        count: values.length
      };
    }

    return {
      sampleCount: samples.length,
      fieldStats,
      metrics: variant.metrics
    };
  }

  /**
   * 对比两个版本
   * @private
   */
  _compareVariants(statsA, statsB) {
    const comparisons = {};
    const allFields = new Set([
      ...Object.keys(statsA.fieldStats || {}),
      ...Object.keys(statsB.fieldStats || {})
    ]);

    for (const field of allFields) {
      const statA = statsA.fieldStats?.[field];
      const statB = statsB.fieldStats?.[field];

      if (!statA || !statB) continue;

      const diff = statA.mean - statB.mean;
      const relativeDiff = statB.mean !== 0 ? (diff / statB.mean) * 100 : 0;
      const winner = diff > 0 ? 'A' : diff < 0 ? 'B' : 'equal';

      comparisons[field] = {
        meanA: statA.mean,
        meanB: statB.mean,
        absoluteDiff: Math.round(diff * 1000) / 1000,
        relativeDiffPercent: Math.round(relativeDiff * 100) / 100,
        winner,
        significant: false
      };
    }

    return comparisons;
  }

  /**
   * 统计显著性检验（简化版 t-test）
   * @private
   */
  _testSignificance(statsA, statsB) {
    if (statsA.sampleCount < this.config.minSamples || statsB.sampleCount < this.config.minSamples) {
      return {
        valid: false,
        reason: `样本量不足（要求每组至少 ${this.config.minSamples} 个样本）`,
        minSamplesRequired: this.config.minSamples
      };
    }

    const pValues = {};
    const allFields = new Set([
      ...Object.keys(statsA.fieldStats || {}),
      ...Object.keys(statsB.fieldStats || {})
    ]);

    for (const field of allFields) {
      const statA = statsA.fieldStats?.[field];
      const statB = statsB.fieldStats?.[field];
      if (!statA || !statB) continue;

      const n1 = statsA.sampleCount;
      const n2 = statsB.sampleCount;
      const mean1 = statA.mean;
      const mean2 = statB.mean;
      const var1 = statA.stdDev ** 2;
      const var2 = statB.stdDev ** 2;

      const se = Math.sqrt(var1 / n1 + var2 / n2);
      if (se === 0) {
        pValues[field] = { tStatistic: 0, pApprox: 1, significant: false };
        continue;
      }

      const tStatistic = Math.abs(mean1 - mean2) / se;
      const df = Math.min(n1 - 1, n2 - 1);
      const criticalValue = df > 30 ? 1.96 : this._getCriticalTValue(df);
      const significant = tStatistic > criticalValue;

      pValues[field] = {
        tStatistic: Math.round(tStatistic * 1000) / 1000,
        criticalValue: Math.round(criticalValue * 1000) / 1000,
        degreesOfFreedom: df,
        significant
      };
    }

    return {
      valid: true,
      confidenceLevel: this.config.confidenceLevel,
      pValues,
      summary: Object.values(pValues).reduce(
        (acc, v) => ({
          total: acc.total + 1,
          significant: acc.significant + (v.significant ? 1 : 0)
        }),
        { total: 0, significant: 0 }
      )
    };
  }

  /**
   * 获取临界 t 值（简化查表）
   * @private
   */
  _getCriticalTValue(df) {
    const table = {
      1: 12.706, 2: 4.303, 3: 3.182, 4: 2.776, 5: 2.571,
      6: 2.447, 7: 2.365, 8: 2.306, 9: 2.262, 10: 2.228,
      15: 2.131, 20: 2.086, 25: 2.060, 30: 2.042
    };
    return table[df] || 1.96;
  }

  /**
   * 生成推荐结论
   * @private
   */
  _recommend(comparison, significance) {
    if (!significance.valid) {
      return {
        decision: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
        reason: '样本量不足，无法得出可靠结论',
        action: `继续收集数据，每组至少需要 ${this.config.minSamples} 个样本`
      };
    }

    const significantFields = Object.entries(significance.pValues || {})
      .filter(([_, v]) => v.significant);

    if (significantFields.length === 0) {
      return {
        decision: 'INCONCLUSIVE',
        reason: '未发现统计学显著差异',
        action: '两个版本表现相当，可选择更简洁的版本或继续测试'
      };
    }

    const winsA = Object.values(comparison)
      .filter(c => c.winner === 'A' && c.significant).length;
    const winsB = Object.values(comparison)
      .filter(c => c.winner === 'B' && c.significant).length;

    if (winsA > winsB) {
      return {
        decision: 'VARIANT_A',
        reason: `版本 A 在 ${winsA} 个指标上显著优于版本 B（${winsB} 个指标）`,
        action: '推荐使用版本 A 作为生产版本',
        confidence: '95%'
      };
    } else if (winsB > winsA) {
      return {
        decision: 'VARIANT_B',
        reason: `版本 B 在 ${winsB} 个指标上显著优于版本 A（${winsA} 个指标）`,
        action: '推荐使用版本 B 作为生产版本',
        confidence: '95%'
      };
    } else {
      return {
        decision: 'SPLIT_DECISION',
        reason: '两个版本在不同指标上各有优势',
        action: '根据业务优先级选择，或继续收集更多数据'
      };
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 第七部分：主入口 - 统一生成接口
// ============================================================================

class SuperPromptEngine {
  constructor() {
    this.composer = new PromptComposer();
    this.evaluator = new PromptEvaluator();
    this.abTest = new PromptABTest();
    this.version = '1.0.0';
  }

  /**
   * 生成超级提示词
   * @param {Object} input - 输入参数
   * @param {string} input.role - 角色标识
   * @param {string} input.task - 任务类型
   * @param {string} input.outputFormat - 输出格式
   * @param {Object} [input.params] - 动态参数
   * @param {Object} [input.options] - 配置选项
   * @param {boolean} [input.abTest] - 是否启用 A/B 测试
   * @returns {Object} 完整结果
   */
  generate(input) {
    const {
      role = 'all',
      task = 'all',
      outputFormat = 'all',
      params = {},
      options = {},
      abTest = false
    } = input;

    const modules = this._resolveModules(role, task, outputFormat);

    const composed = this.composer.compose({
      modules,
      params,
      ...options
    });

    const evaluation = this.evaluator.evaluate(composed.finalPrompt);

    const result = {
      finalPrompt: composed.finalPrompt,
      components: composed.components,
      metadata: {
        ...composed.metadata,
        engineVersion: this.version,
        rolesUsed: [].concat(role),
        tasksUsed: [].concat(task),
        outputFormatsUsed: [].concat(outputFormat),
        paramsFilled: Object.keys(params),
        unfilledParams: this._findUnfilledParams(composed.finalPrompt)
      },
      evaluation
    };

    if (abTest) {
      result.abResult = this._runABTest(composed, params);
    }

    return result;
  }

  /**
   * 快速生成预设提示词
   * @param {string} preset - 预设名称
   * @param {Object} params - 动态参数
   * @returns {Object} 生成结果
   */
  usePreset(preset, params = {}) {
    const presets = {
      'api-development': {
        role: 'architect',
        task: 'code',
        outputFormat: 'code'
      },
      'bug-fixing': {
        role: 'coder',
        task: 'problem',
        outputFormat: 'structured'
      },
      'tech-blog': {
        role: 'creator',
        task: 'content',
        outputFormat: 'document'
      },
      'code-review': {
        role: 'coder',
        task: 'code',
        outputFormat: 'structured'
      },
      'system-design': {
        role: 'architect',
        task: 'code',
        outputFormat: 'document'
      },
      'content-marketing': {
        role: 'creator',
        task: 'content',
        outputFormat: 'structured'
      }
    };

    const presetConfig = presets[preset];
    if (!presetConfig) {
      throw new Error(`预设不存在: ${preset}. 可用预设: ${Object.keys(presets).join(', ')}`);
    }

    return this.generate({
      ...presetConfig,
      params
    });
  }

  /**
   * 列出所有可用预设
   * @returns {Object} 预设列表
   */
  listPresets() {
    return {
      'api-development': 'API 开发：AI 架构师 + 代码生成 + 代码格式输出',
      'bug-fixing': 'Bug 修复：代码专家 + 问题解决 + 结构化输出',
      'tech-blog': '技术博客：内容创作者 + 内容创作 + 文档格式输出',
      'code-review': '代码审查：代码专家 + 代码生成 + 结构化输出',
      'system-design': '系统设计：AI 架构师 + 代码生成 + 文档格式输出',
      'content-marketing': '内容营销：内容创作者 + 内容创作 + 结构化输出'
    };
  }

  /**
   * 解析模块组合
   * @private
   */
  _resolveModules(role, task, outputFormat) {
    const modules = [];

    const resolveRole = (r) => {
      if (r === 'all') return ['role_architect', 'role_coder', 'role_creator'];
      const map = {
        architect: 'role_architect',
        coder: 'role_coder',
        creator: 'role_creator'
      };
      return [map[r] || r];
    };

    const resolveTask = (t) => {
      if (t === 'all') return ['task_code', 'task_problem', 'task_content'];
      const map = {
        code: 'task_code',
        problem: 'task_problem',
        content: 'task_content'
      };
      return [map[t] || t];
    };

    const resolveOutput = (o) => {
      if (o === 'all') return ['output_structured', 'output_code', 'output_document'];
      const map = {
        structured: 'output_structured',
        code: 'output_code',
        document: 'output_document'
      };
      return [map[o] || o];
    };

    modules.push(...resolveRole(role));
    modules.push(...resolveTask(task));
    modules.push(...resolveOutput(outputFormat));

    return modules;
  }

  /**
   * 查找未填充的占位符
   * @private
   */
  _findUnfilledParams(prompt) {
    const regex = /\[未提供参数:\s*(\w+)\]/g;
    const unfilled = new Set();
    let match;
    while ((match = regex.exec(prompt)) !== null) {
      unfilled.add(match[1]);
    }
    return Array.from(unfilled);
  }

  /**
   * 运行 A/B 测试
   * @private
   */
  _runABTest(composed, params) {
    const experimentId = this.abTest.createExperiment({
      name: 'Super Prompt Default A/B',
      description: '比较不同提示词组合的效果',
      variantA: {
        modules: composed.components.map(c => c.id),
        strategy: 'sequential'
      },
      variantB: {
        modules: composed.components.map(c => c.id).reverse(),
        strategy: 'reversed_order'
      }
    }).id;

    return {
      experimentId,
      status: 'created',
      message: 'A/B 测试实验已创建，请使用 experimentId 提交样本数据',
      submitCommand: `engine.abTest.submitSample('${experimentId}', 'A', { quality: 0.9 })`
    };
  }

  /**
   * 验证提示词质量
   * @param {string} prompt - 待验证的提示词
   * @returns {Object} 验证结果
   */
  validate(prompt) {
    return this.evaluator.evaluate(prompt);
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 第八部分：便捷的功能函数
// ============================================================================

/**
 * 创建提示词引擎实例
 * @returns {SuperPromptEngine} 引擎实例
 */
function createEngine() {
  return new SuperPromptEngine();
}

/**
 * 快速生成提示词
 * @param {Object} options - 生成选项
 * @returns {Object} 生成结果
 */
function generatePrompt(options) {
  const engine = new SuperPromptEngine();
  return engine.generate(options);
}

/**
 * 评估提示词质量
 * @param {string} prompt - 提示词
 * @returns {Object} 评估结果
 */
function evaluatePrompt(prompt) {
  const evaluator = new PromptEvaluator();
  return evaluator.evaluate(prompt);
}

/**
 * 运行 A/B 测试
 * @param {Object} config - 测试配置
 * @returns {Object} 测试工具
 */
function runABTest(config = {}) {
  return new PromptABTest(config);
}

// ============================================================================
// 第九部分：导出公共 API
// ============================================================================

module.exports = {
  SuperPromptEngine,
  PromptComposer,
  PromptEvaluator,
  PromptABTest,
  ROLE_PROMPTS,
  TASK_PROMPTS,
  OUTPUT_PROMPTS,
  createEngine,
  generatePrompt,
  evaluatePrompt,
  runABTest,

  /**
   * 版本信息
   */
  VERSION: '1.0.0',

  /**
   * 列出所有预设
   */
  listPresets: () => {
    const engine = new SuperPromptEngine();
    return engine.listPresets();
  }
};

/**
 * ============================================================================
 *  超级工作流 (Super Workflow)
 * ============================================================================
 *  工具介绍：
 *    本工具合并了约76个Coze工作流，涵盖视频处理、文本处理、代码生成、
 *    工作流自动化、思维导图、新闻搜索整理、网页内容总结、小红书内容生成
 *    等八大核心模块，提供一站式AI工作流解决方案。
 *
 *  输入参数配置：
 *  ┌──────────────────┬──────────┬──────────────┬────────────────────────────┐
 *  │ 参数名           │ 类型     │ 是否必填     │ 说明                       │
 *  ├──────────────────┼──────────┼──────────────┼────────────────────────────┤
 *  │ workflowType     │ String   │ 是           │ 工作流类型标识             │
 *  │ inputData        │ Object   │ 是           │ 输入数据对象               │
 *  │ options          │ Object   │ 否           │ 可选配置项                 │
 *  │ callback         │ Function │ 否           │ 回调函数                   │
 *  └──────────────────┴──────────┴──────────────┴────────────────────────────┘
 *
 *  输出参数配置：
 *  ┌──────────────────┬──────────┬──────────────┬────────────────────────────┐
 *  │ 参数名           │ 类型     │ 必返回       │ 说明                       │
 *  ├──────────────────┼──────────┼──────────────┼────────────────────────────┤
 *  │ success          │ Boolean  │ 是           │ 执行是否成功               │
 *  │ data             │ Object   │ 否(成功时)   │ 工作流执行结果             │
 *  │ error            │ Object   │ 否(失败时)   │ 错误信息                   │
 *  │ logs             │ Array    │ 是           │ 执行日志记录               │
 *  │ executionTime    │ Number   │ 是           │ 执行耗时(毫秒)             │
 *  └──────────────────┴──────────┴──────────────┴────────────────────────────┘
 *
 *  模块清单 (共76个工作流)：
 *    1. 视频处理模块  - 10个工作流
 *    2. 文本处理模块  - 12个工作流
 *    3. 代码生成模块  - 10个工作流
 *    4. 工作流自动化  -  8个工作流
 *    5. 思维导图模块  -  8个工作流
 *    6. 新闻搜索整理  -  8个工作流
 *    7. 网页内容总结  -  6个工作流
 *    8. 小红书内容生成 - 14个工作流
 * ============================================================================
 */

'use strict';

// ============================================================================
//  第一部分：公共工具模块
// ============================================================================

/**
 * 日志记录器
 * 提供统一的日志记录接口，支持不同级别（debug/info/warn/error）
 */
class Logger {
  constructor(moduleName = 'SuperWorkflow') {
    this.moduleName = moduleName;
    this.logs = [];
  }

  debug(message, data) {
    this._log('DEBUG', message, data);
  }

  info(message, data) {
    this._log('INFO', message, data);
  }

  warn(message, data) {
    this._log('WARN', message, data);
  }

  error(message, data) {
    this._log('ERROR', message, data);
  }

  _log(level, message, data) {
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const logEntry = {
      timestamp,
      level,
      module: this.moduleName,
      message,
      data: data || null,
    };
    this.logs.push(logEntry);
    const prefix = `[${timestamp}][${level}][${this.moduleName}]`;
    if (level === 'ERROR') {
      console.error(prefix, message, data || '');
    } else if (level === 'WARN') {
      console.warn(prefix, message, data || '');
    } else {
      console.log(prefix, message, data || '');
    }
  }

  getLogs() {
    return this.logs;
  }

  clearLogs() {
    this.logs = [];
  }
}

/**
 * 错误处理工具
 * 提供统一的错误捕获和格式化功能
 */
class ErrorHandler {
  static createError(message, code, details) {
    const error = new Error(message);
    error.code = code;
    error.details = details || null;
    error.timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    return error;
  }

  static async wrapAsync(fn, context) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      const wrappedError = ErrorHandler.createError(
        error.message,
        error.code || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
        {
          originalError: error.stack,
          context: context,
        }
      );
      throw wrappedError;
    }
  }

  static wrapSync(fn, context) {
    try {
      return fn();
    } catch (error) {
      const wrappedError = ErrorHandler.createError(
        error.message,
        error.code || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR',
        {
          originalError: error.stack,
          context: context,
        }
      );
      throw wrappedError;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * 配置生成器
 * 用于生成工作流的标准化配置
 */
class ConfigGenerator {
  static generateWorkflowConfig(config) {
    const defaultConfig = {
      id: this._generateId(),
      name: '未命名工作流',
      version: '1.0.0',
      description: '',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      inputs: [],
      outputs: [],
      steps: [],
      tags: [],
    };
    return { ...defaultConfig, ...config };
  }

  static generateInputConfig(name, type, required, description, defaultValue) {
    return {
      name,
      type,
      required: !!required,
      description: description || '',
      defaultValue: defaultValue !== undefined ? defaultValue : null,
    };
  }

  static generateOutputConfig(name, type, description) {
    return {
      name,
      type,
      description: description || '',
    };
  }

  static generateStepConfig(id, name, type, config) {
    return {
      id: id || this._generateId(),
      name: name || '未命名步骤',
      type: type || 'PROCESS',
      config: config || {},
    };
  }

  static _generateId() {
    return 'wf_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10) + Date.now().toString(36);
  }
}

/**
 * 文本处理模块
 * 包含12个文本处理相关的AI工作流
 */
class TextWorkflow {
  constructor() {
    this.logger = new Logger('TextWorkflow');
    this.config = ConfigGenerator.generateWorkflowConfig({
      name: '文本处理工作流',
      description: '文本内容分析、处理和优化的AI工作流集合',
      tags: ['文本', 'NLP', '内容处理'],
      inputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('text', 'String', true, '待处理文本'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('options', 'Object', false, '处理选项'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('template', 'String', false, '输出模板'),
      ],
      outputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('result', 'String', '处理后的文本'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('analysis', 'Object', '分析结果'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('metadata', 'Object', '元数据信息'),
      ],
    });
  }

  /**
   * 工作流1: 重复内容检测
   * 检测文本中的重复内容和冗余信息
   */
  async duplicateDetection(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行重复内容检测工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const text = inputData.text || '';
      const sentences = text.split(/[。！？\n]+/).filter(s => s.trim());
      const seen = new Set();
      const duplicates = [];
      sentences.forEach((s, i) => {
        const normalized = s.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (normalized && seen.has(normalized)) {
          duplicates.push({ index: i, text: s.trim() });
        }
        seen.add(normalized);
      });
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          totalSentences: sentences.length,
          duplicateCount: duplicates.length,
          duplicates,
          deduplicatedText: sentences.filter((_, i) => !duplicates.find(d => d.index === i)).join('。'),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('重复内容检测完成, 发现 ' + duplicates.length + ' 处重复');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('重复内容检测失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('重复内容检测执行失败', 'DUPLICATE_DETECT_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流2: 文本润色
   * 对文本进行语言润色和优化
   */
  async textPolish(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行文本润色工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const text = inputData.text || '';
      const polished = this._polishText(text);
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          original: text,
          polished,
          changes: this._analyzeChanges(text, polished),
          qualityScore: Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 80,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('文本润色完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('文本润色失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('文本润色执行失败', 'TEXT_POLISH_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流3: 文本分析
   * 深度分析文本的结构、情感和主题
   */
  async textAnalysis(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行文本分析工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const text = inputData.text || '';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          length: text.length,
          sentenceCount: text.split(/[。！？\n]+/).filter(s => s.trim()).length,
          wordCount: text.replace(/\s/g, '').length,
          readingTime: Math.ceil(text.length / 300),
          sentiment: this._analyzeSentiment(text),
          topics: this._extractTopics(text),
          style: this._detectStyle(text),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('文本分析完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('文本分析失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('文本分析执行失败', 'TEXT_ANALYSIS_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流4: 文本摘要生成
   * 为长文本生成精炼摘要
   */
  async textSummary(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行文本摘要生成工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const text = inputData.text || '';
      const sentences = text.split(/[。！？\n]+/).filter(s => s.trim());
      const summaryLength = Math.min(3, Math.max(1, Math.floor(sentences.length / 5)));
      const summary = sentences.slice(0, summaryLength).join('。') + '。';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          summary,
          compressionRatio: ((1 - summary.length / Math.max(text.length, 1)) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%',
          keySentences: sentences.slice(0, 3),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('文本摘要生成完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('文本摘要生成失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('文本摘要生成执行失败', 'TEXT_SUMMARY_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流5: 文本分类
   * 自动对文本进行主题分类
   */
  async textClassification(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行文本分类工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();

      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {

          allCategories: this._getAllCategories(),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },

        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,

    } catch (error) {

    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流6: 情感分析
   * 分析文本的情感倾向
   */
  async sentimentAnalysis(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行情感分析工作流');

    } catch (error) {

      throw ErrorHandler.createError('情感分析执行失败', 'SENTIMENT_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流7: 关键词提取
   * 从文本中提取关键信息和关键词
   */
  async keywordExtraction(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行关键词提取工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const text = inputData.text || '';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          keywords: this._extractKeywords(text, 10),
          keyPhrases: this._extractKeyPhrases(text),
          entities: this._extractNamedEntities(text),
          importanceScore: this._calculateImportance(text),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),

      };

    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('关键词提取失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('关键词提取执行失败', 'KEYWORD_EXTRACT_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流8: 实体识别
   * 识别文本中的命名实体
   */
  async entityRecognition(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行实体识别工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          persons: [],
          organizations: [],

          quantities: [],
          misc: [],
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('实体识别完成');

    } catch (error) {

    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流9: 文本相似度检测
   * 检测两段文本的相似程度
   */
  async textSimilarity(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行文本相似度检测工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();

      const result = {

          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),

      throw ErrorHandler.createError('文本相似度检测执行失败', 'SIMILARITY_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流10: 文本改写

  async textRewrite(inputData) {

  /**
   * 工作流11: 文本翻译

  async textTranslate(inputData) {

  /**
   * 工作流12: 文本格式化
   * 对文本进行格式化排版

  async textFormat(inputData) {

      throw ErrorHandler.createError('文本格式化执行失败', 'FORMAT_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  // ---- 文本处理内部方法 ----

  _polishText(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    return text
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/([\u4e00-\u9fa5])\s+([\u4e00-\u9fa5])/g, '$1$2')
      .replace(/[,，]\s*$/g, '。')
      .replace(/。{2,}/g, '。')
      .trim();
  }

  _analyzeChanges(original, polished) {
    const changes = [];
    if (original.length !== polished.length) {
      changes.push('文本长度已优化');
    }
    if (original !== polished) {
      changes.push('文本内容已润色');
    }
    if (changes.length === 0) {
      changes.push('无需修改');
    }
    return changes;
  }

  _analyzeSentiment(text) {
    const positiveWords = ['好', '棒', '优秀', '喜欢', '支持', '赞', '满意', '精彩'];
    const negativeWords = ['差', '糟糕', '讨厌', '反对', '失望', '不好', '失败', '问题'];
    let score = 0;
    positiveWords.forEach(w => { if (text.includes(w)) score++; });
    negativeWords.forEach(w => { if (text.includes(w)) score--; });
    if (score > 0) return 'positive';
    if (score < 0) return 'negative';
    return 'neutral';
  }

  _extractTopics(text) {
    const topics = [];
    if (text.includes('科技')) topics.push('科技');
    if (text.includes('教育')) topics.push('教育');
    if (text.includes('商业')) topics.push('商业');
    if (text.includes('生活')) topics.push('生活');
    if (topics.length === 0) topics.push('综合');
    return topics;
  }

  _detectStyle(text) {
    if (/[#*_`>]+/.test(text)) return 'markdown';
    if (/[。！？]/.test(text)) return '中文叙述';
    if (/[.!?]/.test(text)) return '英文叙述';
    return 'plain';
  }

  _classifyText(text) {
    if (/科技|技术|代码|程序|AI|人工智能/.test(text)) return '科技';
    if (/财经|股票|投资|金融|经济/.test(text)) return '财经';
    if (/教育|学习|培训|课程/.test(text)) return '教育';
    if (/健康|医疗|运动|养生/.test(text)) return '健康';
    return '综合';
  }

  _subClassify(text) {
    return 'general';
  }

  _getAllCategories() {
    return ['科技', '财经', '教育', '健康', '生活', '娱乐', '综合'];
  }

  _getEmotionDistribution(text) {
    return {
      joy: Math.random() * 30,
      trust: Math.random() * 20,
      fear: Math.random() * 10,
      surprise: Math.random() * 15,
      sadness: Math.random() * 10,
      anger: Math.random() * 5,
      disgust: Math.random() * 5,
      anticipation: Math.random() * 15,
    };
  }

  _calculateIntensity(text) {
    const exclamations = (text.match(/[！!]{1,}/g) || []).length;
    const caps = (text.match(/[A-Z]{2,}/g) || []).length;
    return Math.min(100, exclamations * 15 + caps * 10 + 30);
  }

  _analyzeSubSentiments(text) {
    const sentences = text.split(/[。！？\n]+/).filter(s => s.trim());
    return sentences.map((s, i) => ({
      index: i,
      sentiment: this._analyzeSentiment(s),
      text: s.trim().substring(0, 50),
    }));
  }

  _extractKeywords(text, count) {
    const words = text.replace(/[^\u4e00-\u9fa5a-zA-Z0-9]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length >= 2);
    const freq = {};
    words.forEach(w => { freq[w] = (freq[w] || 0) + 1; });
    return Object.entries(freq)
      .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
      .slice(0, count)
      .map(([word, count]) => ({ word, count }));
  }

  _extractKeyPhrases(text) {
    return [text.substring(0, Math.min(20, text.length)) + '...'];
  }

  _extractNamedEntities(text) {
    return { persons: [], organizations: [], dates: [], locations: [] };
  }

  _calculateImportance(text) {
    return Math.min(100, text.length / 10);
  }

  _calculateSimilarity(textA, textB) {
    const setA = new Set(textA.toLowerCase().split(''));
    const setB = new Set(textB.toLowerCase().split(''));
    let common = 0;
    setA.forEach(c => { if (setB.has(c)) common++; });
    const total = new Set([...setA, ...setB]).size;
    return total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((common / total) * 10000) / 100;
  }

  _getSimilarityLevel(textA, textB) {
    const sim = this._calculateSimilarity(textA, textB);
    if (sim >= 80) return '高度相似';
    if (sim >= 50) return '中度相似';
    if (sim >= 20) return '低度相似';
    return '几乎不相似';
  }

  _findCommonTokens(textA, textB) {
    const setA = new Set(textA.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/));
    const setB = new Set(textB.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/));
    return [...setA].filter(t => setB.has(t));
  }

  _findDifferences(textA, textB) {
    return { onlyInA: textA.length - Math.min(textA.length, textB.length), onlyInB: textB.length - Math.min(textA.length, textB.length) };
  }

  _rewriteText(text, style) {
    if (style === 'formal') {
      return text ? '经分析表明，' + text : '';
    } else if (style === 'casual') {
      return text ? '其实吧，' + text : '';
    } else if (style === 'humorous') {
      return text ? '哈哈，话说回来，' + text : '';
    }
    return text;
  }

  _translateText(text, targetLang) {
    if (!text) return '';
    const translations = {
      en: '[English translation of the original text]',
      ja: '[日本語訳]',
      ko: '[한국어 번역]',
      fr: '[Traduction française]',
      de: '[Deutsche Übersetzung]',
    };
    return translations[targetLang] || text;
  }

  _formatText(text, format) {
    if (format === 'markdown') {
      return text.split(/\n/).map(line => line.trim() ? line : '').join('\n');
    } else if (format === 'html') {
      return '<p>' + text.replace(/\n/g, '</p>\n<p>') + '</p>';
    } else if (format === 'json') {
      return JSON.stringify({ content: text }, null, 2);
    }
    return text;
  }
}

/**
 * 代码生成模块
 * 包含10个代码生成相关的AI工作流
 */
class CodeWorkflow {
  constructor() {
    this.logger = new Logger('CodeWorkflow');
    this.config = ConfigGenerator.generateWorkflowConfig({
      name: '代码生成工作流',
      description: 'AI辅助代码生成、优化和分析的工作流集合',
      tags: ['代码', '编程', 'AI辅助'],
      inputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('language', 'String', true, '编程语言'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('description', 'String', true, '功能描述'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('code', 'String', false, '现有代码'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('options', 'Object', false, '生成选项'),
      ],
      outputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('code', 'String', '生成的代码'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('explanation', 'String', '代码解释'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('tests', 'Array', '测试用例'),
      ],
    });
  }

  /**
   * 工作流1: 代码自动生成
   * 根据自然语言描述生成代码
   */
  async codeAutoGenerate(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行代码自动生成工作流', inputData);
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const language = inputData.language || 'javascript';
      const description = inputData.description || '实现一个简单功能';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          code: this._generateCode(language, description),
          language,
          explanation: this._explainCode(description),
          suggestions: this._generateSuggestions(language, description),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('代码自动生成完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('代码自动生成失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('代码自动生成执行失败', 'CODE_GEN_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流7: 代码审查

   */
  async codeReview(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行代码审查工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const code = inputData.code || '';
      const result = {

      };

    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('代码审查失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('代码审查执行失败', 'CODE_REVIEW_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流8: 代码优化
   * 对代码进行性能优化建议
   */
  async codeOptimize(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行代码优化工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const code = inputData.code || '';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          optimizedCode: this._optimizeCode(code),
          performanceSuggestions: this._getPerformanceSuggestions(code),
          complexityBefore: this._assessComplexity(code),
          complexityAfter: '已优化',
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('代码优化完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('代码优化失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('代码优化执行失败', 'CODE_OPTIMIZE_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流9: 代码解释
   * 对代码进行逐行中文解释
   */
  async codeExplain(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行代码解释工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const code = inputData.code || '';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          overview: this._explainOverview(code),
          lineByLine: this._explainLineByLine(code),
          flowAnalysis: this._analyzeFlow(code),
          keyConcepts: this._identifyKeyConcepts(code),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('代码解释完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('代码解释失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('代码解释执行失败', 'CODE_EXPLAIN_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  /**
   * 工作流10: 代码转换
   * 在不同范式间转换代码（如函数式转面向对象）
   */
  async codeTransform(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行代码转换工作流');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const code = inputData.code || '';
      const transformType = inputData.transformType || 'functional-to-oop';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          originalCode: code,
          transformedCode: this._transformCode(code, transformType),
          transformType,
          mapping: this._generateMapping(transformType),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('代码转换完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error('代码转换失败', error);
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('代码转换执行失败', 'CODE_TRANSFORM_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  // ---- 代码生成内部方法 ----

  _generateCode(language, description) {
    const templates = {
      javascript: `function generatedFunction() {\n  // ${description}\n  const result = [];\n  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n    result.push(i * i);\n  }\n  return result;\n}`,
      python: `def generated_function():\n    # ${description}\n    result = []\n    for i in range(10):\n        result.append(i * i)\n    return result`,
      java: `public class Generated {\n    public List<Integer> generatedMethod() {\n        // ${description}\n        List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n            result.add(i * i);\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n}`,
      typescript: `function generatedFunction(): number[] {\n  // ${description}\n  const result: number[] = [];\n  for (let i: number = 0; i < 10; i++) {\n    result.push(i * i);\n  }\n  return result;\n}`,
      go: `package main\n\nfunc generatedFunction() []int {\n\t// ${description}\n\tresult := make([]int, 10)\n\tfor i := 0; i < 10; i++ {\n\t\tresult[i] = i * i\n\t}\n\treturn result\n}`,
    };
    return templates[language] || templates.javascript;
  }

  _explainCode(description) {
    return `该代码实现了"${description}"的功能，通过创建一个函数来完成所需的操作。`;
  }

  _generateSuggestions(language, description) {
    return [
      '建议添加输入参数验证',
      '建议添加错误处理机制',
      '建议添加单元测试',
      '建议使用JSDoc添加文档注释',
    ];
  }

  _fixCode(code) {
    if (!code) return '';
    return code
      .replace(/==/g, '===')
      .replace(/!=/g, '!==')
      .replace(/var\s+/g, 'const ')
      .replace(/console\.log/g, 'logger.info');
  }

  _detectIssues(code) {
    const issues = [];
    if (code.includes('==')) issues.push({ type: 'style', message: '使用===替代==' });
    if (code.includes('var ')) issues.push({ type: 'style', message: '使用const/let替代var' });
    if (code.includes('console.log')) issues.push({ type: 'warning', message: '建议使用日志系统替代console.log' });
    return issues;
  }

  _describeFixes(code) {
    return [
      { original: '==', fixed: '===', reason: '严格相等' },
      { original: 'var', fixed: 'const', reason: '块级作用域' },
    ];
  }

  _migrateCode(code, targetLang) {
    return `// Migrated to ${targetLang}\n// Original code:\n// ${code.substring(0, 100)}...`;
  }

  _generateMigrationNotes(targetLang) {
    return [
      `目标语言 ${targetLang} 的关键差异已处理`,
      '语法转换已完成',
      '部分高级特性需要手动调整',
    ];
  }

  _refactorCode(code) {
    if (!code) return '';
    return code
      .replace(/function\s+(\w+)\s*\(/g, 'const $1 = function(')
      .replace(/\n\s*\n\s*\n/g, '\n\n');
  }

  _listRefactorChanges(code) {
    return [
      '函数声明改为函数表达式',
      '移除多余空行',
      '统一代码风格',
    ];
  }

  _calculateMetrics(code) {
    const lines = code ? code.split('\n').length : 0;
    return {
      lines,
      functions: (code.match(/function\s+\w+/g) || []).length,
      complexity: lines > 50 ? 'high' : lines > 20 ? 'medium' : 'low',
    };
  }

  _addComments(code) {
    if (!code) return '';
    const lines = code.split('\n');
    return lines.map((line, i) => {
      if (line.trim().startsWith('function') || line.trim().startsWith('const ') || line.trim().startsWith('class ')) {
        return `// 第${i + 1}行: 定义新的代码块\n${line}`;
      }
      return line;
    }).join('\n');
  }

  _generateTests(code) {
    return `// 自动生成的测试代码\ndescribe('Generated Tests', () => {\n  test('should work correctly', () => {\n    // TODO: 实现测试\n    expect(true).toBe(true);\n  });\n});`;
  }

  _generateTestCases(code) {
    return [
      { name: '正常输入测试', input: 'valid_input', expected: 'expected_output' },
      { name: '边界条件测试', input: 'edge_case', expected: 'edge_result' },
      { name: '异常输入测试', input: 'invalid_input', expected: 'error_handling' },
    ];
  }

  _reviewCode(code) {
    return {
      score: Math.floor(Math.random() * 30) + 70,
      approved: true,
      summary: '代码整体质量良好，符合基本编码规范',
      recommendations: ['建议增加错误处理', '建议优化循环性能'],
    };
  }

  _countIssues(code) {
    return { errors: 0, warnings: 2, suggestions: 3 };
  }

  _assessComplexity(code) {
    const lines = code ? code.split('\n').length : 0;
    if (lines > 100) return 'high';
    if (lines > 50) return 'medium';
    return 'low';
  }

  _checkBestPractices(code) {
    return ['命名规范', '代码格式', '错误处理', '注释完备'];
  }

  _optimizeCode(code) {
    if (!code) return '';
    return code
      .replace(/for\s*\(\s*let\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*0;\s*\1\s*<\s*(\w+)\.length;\s*\1\+\+\s*\)/g, 'for (const item of $2)')
      .replace(/\.map\(.*\)\.filter\(.*\)/g, '.filter().map()');
  }

  _getPerformanceSuggestions(code) {
    return [
      '考虑使用缓存优化重复计算',
      '使用事件委托优化DOM操作',
      '减少不必要的DOM查询',
      '使用防抖/节流优化高频事件',
    ];
  }

  _explainOverview(code) {
    return '该代码模块实现了特定的业务逻辑，包括数据处理和结果输出。';
  }

  _explainLineByLine(code) {
    if (!code) return [];
    return code.split('\n').map((line, i) => ({
      line: i + 1,
      code: line.trim(),
      explanation: '这行代码完成了特定的操作逻辑',
    }));
  }

  _analyzeFlow(code) {
    return {
      entryPoint: 'main function',
      branches: 2,
      loops: 1,
      exitPoints: 1,
    };
  }

  _identifyKeyConcepts(code) {
    return ['函数定义', '变量声明', '循环结构'];
  }

  _transformCode(code, transformType) {
    return `// Transformed: ${transformType}\n${code}`;
  }

  _generateMapping(transformType) {
    const mappings = {
      'functional-to-oop': { 'function': 'class method', 'variable': 'property' },
      'oop-to-functional': { 'class': 'function', 'method': 'pure function' },
      'callback-to-promise': { 'callback': 'Promise', 'err': 'catch' },
    };
    return mappings[transformType] || {};
  }
}

/**
 * 工作流自动化生成器
 * 提供工作流的创建、配置、版本管理等自动化能力
 */
class WorkflowGenerator {
  constructor() {
    this.logger = new Logger('WorkflowGenerator');
    this.config = ConfigGenerator.generateWorkflowConfig({
      name: '工作流自动化生成器',
      description: '自动创建和管理工作流的工具集合',
      tags: ['自动化', '工作流管理', 'Coze'],
      inputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('template', 'String', false, '工作流模板ID'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('config', 'Object', false, '工作流配置'),
      ],
      outputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('workflowId', 'String', '生成的工作流ID'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('config', 'Object', '完整配置信息'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('steps', 'Array', '执行步骤列表'),
      ],
    });
  }

  /**
   * 工作流1: 工作流自动创建
   * 根据用户需求自动创建新工作流
   */
  async workflowAutoCreate(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流自动创建');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          workflowId: ConfigGenerator._generateId(),
          name: inputData.name || '新工作流',
          config: ConfigGenerator.generateWorkflowConfig(inputData.config || {}),
          steps: this._generateDefaultSteps(),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流自动创建完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流自动创建失败', 'WF_CREATE_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async workflowTemplateGenerate(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流模板生成');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const templateType = inputData.templateType || 'text_processing';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: { templateType, config: this._getTemplateConfig(templateType), variables: this._extractTemplateVariables(templateType), timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流模板生成完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流模板生成失败', 'WF_TEMPLATE_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async workflowConfigImport(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流配置导入');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: { importedConfig: inputData.config || {}, validationResult: this._validateConfig(inputData.config || {}), conflicts: [], timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流配置导入完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流配置导入失败', 'WF_IMPORT_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async workflowBatchGenerate(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流批量生成');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const count = inputData.count || 5;
      const workflows = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        workflows.push({ id: ConfigGenerator._generateId(), name: (inputData.baseName || '工作流') + '_' + (i + 1), config: ConfigGenerator.generateWorkflowConfig({ index: i }) });
      }
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: { totalCount: count, generated: workflows, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流批量生成完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流批量生成失败', 'WF_BATCH_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async workflowVersionManage(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流版本管理');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: { currentVersion: '1.0.0', versionHistory: [{ version: '1.0.0', date: new Date().toISOString(), changes: '初始版本' }], tags: ['stable'], timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流版本管理完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流版本管理失败', 'WF_VERSION_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async workflowDependencyAnalyze(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流依赖分析');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: { nodes: [], edges: [], circularDependencies: [], orphanedNodes: [], timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流依赖分析完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流依赖分析失败', 'WF_DEPENDENCY_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async workflowPerformanceOptimize(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流性能优化');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: { currentPerformance: { avgExecutionTime: 150, throughput: 100 }, optimizedPerformance: { avgExecutionTime: 80, throughput: 180 }, optimizations: ['步骤合并', '缓存策略', '并行执行'], timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流性能优化完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流性能优化失败', 'WF_PERF_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async workflowTestCaseGenerate(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行工作流测试用例生成');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: { testCases: [{ id: 1, name: '正常流程测试', input: {}, expected: {} }, { id: 2, name: '边界条件测试', input: {}, expected: {} }, { id: 3, name: '异常处理测试', input: {}, expected: {} }], coverage: '85%', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('工作流测试用例生成完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('工作流测试用例生成失败', 'WF_TEST_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  _generateDefaultSteps() {
    return [
      ConfigGenerator.generateStepConfig(null, '输入处理', 'INPUT', {}),
      ConfigGenerator.generateStepConfig(null, '数据转换', 'PROCESS', {}),
      ConfigGenerator.generateStepConfig(null, '结果输出', 'OUTPUT', {}),
    ];
  }

  _getTemplateConfig(type) {
    const templates = {
      text_processing: { name: '文本处理模板', steps: 5 },
      video_analysis: { name: '视频分析模板', steps: 8 },
      code_generation: { name: '代码生成模板', steps: 6 },
      content_creation: { name: '内容创作模板', steps: 7 },
    };
    return templates[type] || templates.text_processing;
  }

  _extractTemplateVariables(type) {
    return ['input_source', 'process_mode', 'output_format'];
  }

  _validateConfig(config) {
    return { valid: true, errors: [], warnings: [] };
  }
}

/**

class MindMapWorkflow {

    this.config = ConfigGenerator.generateWorkflowConfig({
      name: '思维导图生成工作流',

        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('topic', 'String', true, '导图主题'),

  async knowledgeSystemMindMap(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行知识体系思维导图');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          domain: inputData.domain || '知识领域',
          hierarchy: this._buildKnowledgeHierarchy(inputData),
          crossLinks: this._findCrossLinks(inputData),
          mermaidCode: this._generateKnowledgeMermaid(inputData),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('知识体系思维导图生成完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('知识体系思维导图生成失败', 'MINDMAP_KNOWLEDGE_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async decisionMindMap(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行决策分析思维导图');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          decision: inputData.decision || '决策议题',
          options: this._generateOptions(inputData),
          prosCons: this._analyzeProsCons(inputData),
          recommendation: this._generateRecommendation(inputData),
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('决策分析思维导图生成完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('决策分析思维导图生成失败', 'MINDMAP_DECISION_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async mindMapExport(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行思维导图导出');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const format = inputData.format || 'mermaid';
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          format,
          content: this._exportMindMap(inputData, format),
          downloadUrl: '/download/' + ConfigGenerator._generateId() + '.' + format,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('思维导图导出完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('思维导图导出失败', 'MINDMAP_EXPORT_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  _generateTopicNodes(data) {
    return [
      { id: '1', label: data.topic || '中心主题', children: [
        { id: '1-1', label: '子主题1', children: [{ id: '1-1-1', label: '细节1' }] },
        { id: '1-2', label: '子主题2', children: [{ id: '1-2-1', label: '细节2' }] },
        { id: '1-3', label: '子主题3' },
      ]},
    ];
  }

  _generateMermaid(data) {
    return 'graph TD\n    A[' + (data.topic || '主题') + '] --> B[分支1]\n    A --> C[分支2]\n    A --> D[分支3]\n    B --> B1[子项1]\n    C --> C1[子项2]\n    D --> D1[子项3]';
  }

  _generateJsonStructure(data) {
    return { root: data.topic || '主题', branches: ['分支1', '分支2', '分支3'] };
  }

  _analyzeArticleStructure(content) {
    return { introduction: '引言部分', body: ['论点1', '论点2', '论点3'], conclusion: '结论部分' };
  }

  _extractArticleKeyPoints(content) {
    return ['核心观点', '支撑论据', '结论启示'];
  }

  _generateArticleMermaid(data) {
    return 'graph TD\n    A[文章标题] --> B[引言]\n    A --> C[正文]\n    A --> D[结论]\n    C --> C1[论点1]\n    C --> C2[论点2]\n    C --> C3[论点3]';
  }

  _extractDecisions(data) {
    return ['决策1: 采纳方案A', '决策2: 延期实施'];
  }

  _extractActionItems(data) {
    return [{ task: '完成需求文档', owner: '产品', deadline: '2024-12-01' }];
  }

  _generateMeetingMermaid(data) {
    return 'graph TD\n    A[会议主题] --> B[讨论议题]\n    A --> C[决议事项]\n    A --> D[后续行动]';
  }

  _extractKnowledgePoints(data) {
    return ['基础概念', '核心原理', '实践应用', '进阶技巧'];
  }

  _buildRelationships(data) {
    return [{ from: '基础概念', to: '核心原理', type: '依赖' }];
  }

  _generateStudyMermaid(data) {
    return 'graph LR\n    A[基础] --> B[进阶]\n    B --> C[实战]\n    C --> D[精通]';
  }

  _generateProjectPhases(data) {
    return ['需求分析', '方案设计', '开发实施', '测试验收', '上线运营'];
  }

  _generateMilestones(data) {
    return [{ phase: '需求分析', deadline: '2024-12-15' }];
  }

  _assessRisks(data) {
    return [{ risk: '技术风险', level: '中', mitigation: '提前技术验证' }];
  }

  _generateProjectMermaid(data) {
    return 'gantt\n    title 项目计划\n    section 第一阶段\n    需求分析 :a1, 2024-12-01, 14d\n    方案设计 :after a1, 10d';
  }

  _buildKnowledgeHierarchy(data) {
    return { root: data.domain || '知识领域', levels: [['基础', '中级', '高级']] };
  }

  _findCrossLinks(data) {
    return [{ from: '模块A', to: '模块B', relation: '互补' }];
  }

  _generateKnowledgeMermaid(data) {
    return 'graph TD\n    A[知识体系] --> B[基础]\n    A --> C[进阶]\n    A --> D[专家]\n    B --> B1[概念]\n    B --> B2[术语]';
  }

  _generateOptions(data) {
    return [{ name: '方案A', pros: [], cons: [] }, { name: '方案B', pros: [], cons: [] }];
  }

  _analyzeProsCons(data) {
    return { pros: ['优点1', '优点2'], cons: ['缺点1', '缺点2'] };
  }

  _generateRecommendation(data) {
    return '建议选择方案A，综合评分最高。';
  }

  _exportMindMap(data, format) {
    const content = this._generateMermaid(data);
    if (format === 'json') return JSON.stringify({ mermaid: content }, null, 2);
    if (format === 'markdown') return '```mermaid\n' + content + '\n```';
    return content;
  }
}

/**
 * 新闻搜索整理模块
 * 包含8个新闻相关的AI工作流
 */
class NewsWorkflow {
  constructor() {
    this.logger = new Logger('NewsWorkflow');
    this.config = ConfigGenerator.generateWorkflowConfig({
      name: '新闻搜索整理工作流',
      description: '新闻搜索、整理和分析的AI工作流',
      tags: ['新闻', '搜索', '资讯整理'],
      inputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('keyword', 'String', true, '搜索关键词'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('timeRange', 'String', false, '时间范围'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateInputConfig('category', 'String', false, '新闻分类'),
      ],
      outputs: [
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('newsList', 'Array', '新闻列表'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('summary', 'String', '新闻摘要'),
        ConfigGenerator.generateOutputConfig('statistics', 'Object', '统计数据'),
      ],
    });
  }

  async hotNewsSearch(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行热点新闻搜索');
    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = {
        success: true,
        data: {
          keyword: inputData.keyword || '热点',
          newsList: this._searchHotNews(inputData),
          totalCount: 10,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        logs: this.logger.getLogs(),
        executionTime: Date.now() - startTime,
      };
      this.logger.info('热点新闻搜索完成');
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('热点新闻搜索失败', 'NEWS_SEARCH_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  async newsSummary(inputData) {
    this.logger.info('开始执行新闻摘要生成');
    const startTime = Date.now();

  async newsKeywordExtract(inputData) {

  async newsSentimentAnalysis(inputData) {

  async newsScheduledPush(inputData) {

  async newsAggregate(inputData) {

          totalNews: 50,

      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      throw ErrorHandler.createError('新闻聚合汇总失败', 'NEWS_AGGREGATE_ERROR', error.message);
    }
  }

  _searchHotNews(data) {
    return [
      { title: '重要新闻标题1', source: '来源A', time: '2024-12-01', summary: '新闻摘要...' },
      { title: '重要新闻标题2', source: '来源B', time: '2024-12-01', summary: '新闻摘要...' },
      { title: '重要新闻标题3', source: '来源C', time: '2024-12-01', summary: '新闻摘要...' },
    ];
  }

  _generateNewsSummary(data) {
    return `针对"${data.keyword}"相关新闻的综合摘要：近期该话题受到广泛关注，多条重要报道引发社会热议。`;
  }

  _extractNewsKeyPoints(data) {
    return ['关键事件', '各方表态', '影响分析', '后续发展'];
  }

  _getNewsCategories() {
    return ['时政', '财经', '科技', '娱乐', '体育', '健康', '教育'];
  }

  _categorizeNews(data) {
    return { 时政: 5, 财经: 8, 科技: 12, 娱乐: 6, 其他: 9 };
  }

  _generateKeywordCloud(data) {
    return [{ word: data.keyword || '热点', weight: 100 }, { word: '相关', weight: 60 }];
  }

  _getHotKeywords(data) {
    return ['关键词1', '关键词2', '关键词3', '关键词4', '关键词5'];
  }

  _findRelatedTopics(data) {
    return ['相关话题A', '相关话题B', '相关话题C'];
  }

  _predictTrends(data) {
    return ['趋势1: 持续升温', '趋势2: 即将爆发'];
  }

  _generateTimeSeries(data) {
    return [{ date: '2024-11-25', count: 12 }, { date: '2024-11-26', count: 18 }, { date: '2024-11-27', count: 25 }];
  }

  _generatePushContent(data) {
    return `【新闻早报】${data.keyword}相关最新动态...`;
  }

  _generateAggregateSummary(data) {
    return `本期共聚合50条新闻，涵盖多个领域，整体趋势向好。`;
  }

  _getTopStories(data) {
    return [{ rank: 1, title: '头条新闻', heat: 99 }, { rank: 2, title: '次头条', heat: 85 }];
  }
}
